plugins.description:
12andus Astrology delivers professional-grade astrological insights powered by precise calculations and personalized charts analysis.

What You Can Explore

Personality & Psychological Insights
Discover your strengths, challenges, emotional patterns, and inner motivations based on your unique birth chart. Understand how you think, love, work, and
make decisions through the lens of your planetary placements.

Timing Guidance & Forecasts
Receive personalized transit forecasts for up to one year ahead, revealing upcoming periods of growth, change, opportunity, or challenge. See when
key planetary influences begin and end.

Relationship Compatibility
Explore the dynamics between you and anyone else through synastry analysis (how your charts interact) and composite charts (the unique energy your
relationship creates together). For romantic relationships, understand the chemistry of attraction, emotional compatibility, communication styles, intimacy patterns, and long-term potential. The same depth of analysis applies to any relationship — family bonds, friendships, business partnerships, or professional collaborations. See where you naturally harmonize, where friction may arise, and how to navigate differences with greater awareness.

Relationship Timing
Go beyond static compatibility — see how transiting planets activate your composite chart, revealing the best times for important relationship milestones,
conversations, or decisions.

Key Features
- Private Birth Data Storage — Securely save up to 50 birth charts under your account for instant access to readings without re-entering data
- Birth Charts — Complete natal analysis including planets, houses, aspects, and retrograde positions
- Transit Charts — Forecasts from 1 day to 365 days showing active planetary influences
- Relationship Charts — Synastry and composite analysis between any two saved people
- Relationship Forecasts — Transits to composite charts revealing relationship timing

Unmatched Precision
12andus calculations consider the exact planetary positions based on your specific birth date, time, and place. When birth time is unknown, the system adapts intelligently, providing insights without house-dependent data.

Holistic Readings
Unlike fragmented interpretations that list placements one by one, 12andus synthesizes your chart holistically — weaving together planetary positions, aspects, and houses into a unified narrative that reflects how these energies actually work together in your life.

plugins.name: app-69fa6610711c8191bffd677557adee04
plugins.description:
1to1 Mate is a relationship management app built around 1:1 meetings.

It is an "external memory" tool for people whose work depends on stacking one-on-one conversations — sales professionals,
community builders, managers, founders, advisors, and anyone who runs recurring 1:1s.

CORE FEATURES

・Member management: Structured storage of each person's goals, values, skills, referral needs, background, and tags
・AI meeting notes: Automatic transcription of meeting audio with AI-generated summaries and action items
・Dashboard: Chronological view of who you met, when, and what you discussed
・Profile import: Extract member information from business cards or web pages
・Referral matching: AI suggests who to introduce to whom based on past conversations

Note: the above are features of the 1to1 Mate app itself. Audio transcription, new meeting note creation, and member
registration all happen inside the 1to1 Mate app. The MCP / ChatGPT integration only provides read-only access to data already
 recorded through those features.

WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH CHATGPT

Once you connect 1to1 Mate to ChatGPT, you can ask things like:

・"Draft the next agenda for my 1:1 with Tanaka based on what we discussed last time."
・"Find members who are struggling with marketing."
・"Who on my member list would be a good introduction for Yamada, given her goals?"
・"Summarize the action items I committed to across last month's 1:1s."

The AI reads your data on a strictly read-only basis. Nothing is modified or deleted through this connection.

PERMISSIONS & DATA HANDLING

・A Pro plan subscription is required to connect
・Authentication via OAuth 2.1 with PKCE; sign in with your Google account
・Raw contact details (phone numbers, email addresses, messaging IDs) are never exposed to the AI. Not even the channel type label is returned — the MCP layer simply omits all contact-related fields
・You can disconnect the integration at any time from your account settings

See https://1to1mate.com/guide/mcp for the full connection walkthrough and the exact fields each tool returns.

plugins.description:
60fps is a library of real iOS app interactions, recorded from shipping apps and broken down so
you can build them.

Search in plain language, like "springy bottom sheet" or "pull to refresh with haptics", and get
back matching shots with the app, the gesture, and the motion vocabulary that describes them. Open
one for a frame by frame breakdown of the animation: what moves, in what order, with what timing
and easing. Where a bespoke recreation exists, you can pull compile-checked SwiftUI for it.

It answers the question a reference video cannot: not just what an interaction looks like, but what
it is actually doing.

Read only. It never writes anything and never acts on your behalf.

plugins.name: app-6a6f945292888191a7d77db4893f8520
plugins.description:
@imqueue is an open-source TypeScript framework for building microservices that
talk over a message queue instead of HTTP — you write a class, decorate the
methods you want to publish, and callers get a fully-typed client generated from
the running service.

This server gives your assistant first-hand knowledge of it, so it writes real
@imqueue code instead of plausible-looking code.

search_docs covers the guides, the tutorial, the CLI manual, the articles, and
every exported symbol of every @imqueue package that publishes an API reference —
so you can ask a question in plain words ("how do I expose a service method?") or
look up an exact signature ("RedisQueue.send", "IMQOptions.safeDelivery").
Results carry page URLs, and get_doc returns any page as plain markdown for
reading and quoting. list_packages returns the current package catalogue with
install commands, which is how an assistant picks the right one rather than
guessing at a name. Where two packages cover the same ground — tracing, or the
database layer — the results carry the rule for choosing exactly one, because
installing both breaks quietly rather than loudly.

scaffold_service generates an idiomatic service — an IMQService subclass with
@expose()d, JSDoc-typed methods plus a bootstrap that starts it — from the method
signatures you describe. A custom return type comes back with the @classType() and
@property() decorators it needs, which matters because a field that lacks them
reaches the generated client typed any and still compiles. scaffold_client shows
how to generate and use the typed client for a service. Both return source text
for you to review and paste; neither writes a file.

All six tools are read-only. The server has no accounts, no authentication and no
storage: each request is handled statelessly, and the only data it sees is the
argument you send — a search query, a doc URL, a service name. Nothing is
retained, and no conversation content is collected or used for training.

Tools that would act on your own machine — driving the imq CLI, creating projects
on disk, starting and stopping your services, reading their logs — are
deliberately not part of this server, because a hosted server cannot reach your
machine and should not claim to. They ship in the local install instead
(npx -y @imqueue/mcp), and local_install_guide returns the setup steps for it.

plugins.description:
AB (ActionBridge) provides a secure and reliable integration layer between your AI agents and Microsoft Teams. It enables your models to interact directly with your workspace, transforming passive AI insights into active participants in your team's daily operations.

Key Features
Direct Teams Connectivity: Seamlessly link your AI models to Microsoft Teams channels and private chats.

Workflow Automation: Trigger real-time messages, notifications, and status updates based on agent-driven logic.

Secure Integration: Designed as a professional conduit to ensure stable data flow between LLMs and enterprise communication hubs.

Why You’ll Love It
AB eliminates the need to manually relay information between your AI tools and your team. By allowing your agent to communicate where the work happens, it reduces context switching and ensures that AI-generated actions are delivered instantly to the right stakeholders. Whether you are automating project updates or facilitating AI-driven collaboration, AB makes your agents more actionable and effective.

plugins.description:
Adobe unlocks more ways to create and get work done from the conversation. Previously available as Photoshop, the Adobe connector now brings creativity and productivity capabilities across Creative Cloud and Acrobat. Describe what you want to make or change, and Adobe can help turn ideas, images, videos, and documents into polished outputs — from editing photos and creating PDFs to designing social assets, resizing videos, searching Creative Cloud assets, and generating data-driven documents.
Key capabilities:

* Retouch portraits or edit photos in bulk: Drop in photos and describe the look you want — adjust color, lighting, and tone; remove distractions and generate new elements; apply Lightroom presets; remove backgrounds; blur, crop, resize, and expand images.
* Design from template: Start from an Express template, update text and colors, and then animate for social media or convert to PDF.
* Refine video for any platform: Upload a horizontal clip and ask to reformat it for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, or any platform. You can also stitch clips into a single sequence.
* Search and organize creative work: Describe what you're looking for and surface assets from your Creative Cloud library — by subject, style, mood, or content — without browsing folders.
* Work with PDFs and documents: Create and convert polished PDFs and documents.
* Create data-driven documents: Describe your output and provide your data — the connector turns raw data or content into formatted, shareable PDFs, including badges, cards, catalogs, and more.

You can get started as a guest, and sign in with your Adobe account for more capabilities and tools, Creative Cloud storage, and saved work across sessions.

plugins.description:
Liner is an agentic AI search that finds, verifies, and summarizes answers with real-time web data and cited sources. Ask a question and Liner searches the live web, scrapes and crawls current pages, and returns a grounded answer you can fact-check against the original source — the latest news and up-to-date information, not stale training data.

Use Liner to:

- Search the real-time web and get verified, cited answers
- Summarize PDFs, research papers, and long documents
- Fact-check and verify claims against primary sources
- Find and read academic papers and scholarly research
- Get the latest news and up-to-date information on any topic
- Create market, company, or product briefs
- Compare viewpoints across multiple sources
- Turn a broad question into a structured, cited report

Built for agents and builders: 

Liner works as a grounded search and retrieval layer for AI agents, MCP workflows, and anyone building with real-time information. A reliable alternative to Exa, Tavily, Elicit, SciSpace, and Scite for search, retrieval, and academic discovery.

Liner covers web search, academic search, fact-checking, summarization, PDF reading, paper discovery, real-time news, scraping, and crawling — all with verifiable citations.

Need a fast cited answer or a full report? Liner does both — quick research for speed, deep research when you need more context before a decision. Also available as an API, so teams building AI products can tap the same search and research capabilities directly.

plugins.name: app-6a4ea51b44c48191b49f0b14c7c83897
plugins.description:
AgentMail gives AI agents their own email inboxes. Through this connector, an agent (or you, in ChatGPT) can spin up a dedicated inbox on the fly, then send, receive, reply to, and forward email, with full thread context, drafts, and attachments, entirely through tool calls.

Unlike traditional email APIs built for one-way notifications, AgentMail is built for two-way conversations: an agent can read an incoming thread, understand it, and respond in context, just like a person would. This makes email a first-class communication and identity channel for agents, letting them sign up for services, coordinate with people, and talk to other agents.

Key capabilities exposed over MCP:
• Inboxes: create, list, get, update, and delete agent inboxes
• Messages: send, reply, forward, list, and update
• Threads: list, read, label, and delete full conversation threads
• Search: full-text search across threads and messages
• Drafts: create, list, read, update, send (with scheduling), and delete
• Attachments: retrieve attachments by ID, with text extraction for PDF/DOCX

Connect in seconds via OAuth using your AgentMail console identity. No API key required in ChatGPT. Sign up free at console.agentmail.to.

plugins.description:
Factagora — Explore Truth Through Interactive Argument Graphs

Don't just get an answer — see how it was reached.

Factagora turns claims and predictions into interactive knowledge graphs where adversarial AI agents debate opposing viewpoints and generate transparent verdicts. Each node represents a claim, piece of evidence, or argument; each connection shows how they relate. Click through the graph to understand the reasoning behind every conclusion.

What you get:
• Verdicts — TRUE / FALSE / UNCERTAIN with confidence scores from adversarial AI debate
• Evidence — Credibility-scored sources supporting or opposing the claim
• AI Debate — Multiple AI agents (Skeptic, Analyst, Optimist) argue their positions with cited reasoning
• Interactive Graph — Navigate the full argument map visually, not just as a list

Ideal for researchers, journalists, analysts, students, and anyone who wants to understand why something is true — not just that it is.

Sample prompts:
• "Is nuclear energy the safest large-scale energy source?"
• "Will AGI be achieved before 2040?"
• "Is Trump making money from his presidency?"

plugins.description:
Vibe Prospecting brings live B2B data into ChatGPT for prospecting, lead research, and data enrichment. It draws on a database of 150M+ companies and 800M+ professional contacts aggregated from 50+ sources, so you can build lead lists, research accounts, and fill in missing contact data without leaving the conversation.

Search for companies. Describe your ideal customer profile in plain language and filter by industry (including LinkedIn industry, NAICS, and SIC classifications), employee count, revenue range, location, funding stage, and the technologies a company uses. Results come back as structured lists you can refine, rank, and export.

Find the right people. Search professional contacts by job title, seniority, department, location, skills, and work history. Look up a specific person by name and company, or map the decision-makers across a target account, including org structure and reporting lines, to plan multi-threaded outreach.

Get contact details. Retrieve business emails and phone numbers for the contacts you find, with verification status included, so outreach lists are ready to use. Fill gaps in partial records, for example a name and company with no email. Verify email addresses you already have before a send, and flag records that need replacing.

Track buying signals. See which companies raised funding, announced news, grew headcount, opened relevant job listings, or had key people change roles. Use these events to time outreach, score leads, and prioritize accounts.

Enrich your existing records. Paste or upload a list of companies or contacts and append firmographics, technographics, contact details, and recent signals. The app matches records to the right company or person, flags duplicates, and returns a clean table you can export to CSV for your CRM, ATS, or outreach tools.

Who it's for. Sales teams and SDRs building qualified pipeline. Recruiters sourcing candidates by role, skills, and location. RevOps and marketing teams segmenting accounts, sizing markets, and improving CRM data quality. It also supports market sizing and TAM analysis, lead scoring, territory planning, and account-based marketing list building.

Try prompts like:

"Find US SaaS companies with 100 to 1,000 employees that use HubSpot."
"Identify VP-level decision-makers at these accounts and get verified work emails."
"Enrich this list with industry, employee count, revenue, and tech stack."
"Which of these companies raised funding or grew headcount in the last 6 months?"
"Find backend engineers in Austin with fintech experience and get their profiles."
"Build a target account list for my ICP and rank it by fit."
"Map the sales leadership org chart at this company."
"Verify the emails in this list and flag the risky ones."
"Estimate how many US companies match this ICP."
"Write a personalized cold email opener for each contact based on their company's recent news."
Vibe Prospecting is built on Explorium's B2B data platform. Data is retrieved live at query time, not from a static export, so results reflect current company and contact information.

AI Wisebase is your personal knowledge base. It allows you to use your saved files and chat history directly within ChatGPT to generate responses grounded in your own data.

1. Organize Your Files and Chats
Save Chat History: Save important ChatGPT chats as editable documents for future reference.

Upload Files: Add your personal files to your knowledge base to build your private library.

Connect: Link AI Wisebase to your ChatGPT account.

plugins.description:
Airepoto connects ChatGPT to your meeting recordings, transcripts, and AI summaries.

Find meetings across your workspaces and groups, read speaker-labeled transcripts, and get AI summaries with action items — all in natural language, without leaving the conversation.

What you can do
- Search and list meetings across workspaces, groups, and keywords
- Read full transcripts with speaker labels
- Read AI summaries, including decisions and action items
- Ask questions that span several meetings at once
- Create meeting minutes from an audio file, request a new AI summary, move minutes between groups, or move minutes to the trash

Access and privacy
Airepoto uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. Every request is scoped to the signed-in user: the server resolves the verified email claim in the access token to an Airepoto member, and rejects any token without one. You only ever see the meetings your Airepoto account already has access to. Deletion moves minutes to the trash, where they can be restored.

Airepoto is a meeting recording, transcription, and AI-summary service by RSUPPORT Co., Ltd. An Airepoto account is required.

Ask for a briefing and the executive assistant reads your connected mailbox and calendar to tell you what needs attention today, what decisions are pending, and what you're still waiting on. Ask about sales and you get live pipeline figures, your leads ranked by score across campaigns, and a personalised outreach email drafted for whichever lead you name. plugins.description:
Atlas Red is a workspace for structured mind maps. A map is a tree of topics, and every topic in a map shares the same author-defined fields — plain text, or typed ones like a select with its own options, a number or a date — so a map behaves like a small database you can see.

Connect your account and you can create maps, read a single topic's neighbourhood without pulling in the whole map, add and reorganise topics, fill in typed fields, link topics across branches, and import or export maps as Markdown, OPML, YAML and other formats. Every change is saved to your account, and anything you do here can be undone — from this conversation or later in the app.

The maps persist and stay yours: the same map opens in the Atlas Red web app on any device, on a visual canvas where you can rearrange it, colour it by one of its fields, attach images and share a read-only link.

AuthorityPrompt helps organizations create, manage, and improve the trusted information AI systems use to understand their business.

As AI search and AI assistants increasingly influence customer decisions, companies need more than websites and marketing content. They need a trusted, structured, and verifiable company record that AI systems can reliably interpret.

AuthorityPrompt provides a complete AI Visibility and AI Resolution platform that helps organizations understand, improve, and manage how they are represented across AI ecosystems.

With AuthorityPrompt, you can:

• Run LLM Visibility Assessments to evaluate how AI systems understand your company

• Identify gaps, inconsistencies, and missing information affecting AI understanding

• Receive prioritized Growth Tasks with actionable recommendations

• Monitor AI Description Changes over time

• Build and maintain an AIO Knowledge Profile for your organization

• Create a Canonical AI Profile that serves as an authoritative source of truth

• Manage Verified Claims supported by trusted evidence and sources

• Organize company facts through a centralized Fact Center

• Analyze trust, credibility, and source consistency with AI Trust Intelligence

• Discover and manage Trusted Sources that influence AI-generated answers

• Generate AI Action Pages designed for machine-readable consumption

• Create structured data, JSON-LD, llms.txt, and other AI-ready formats

• Review LLM Analytics and visibility reports across AI systems

• Configure Setup Agents to guide implementation and optimization

• Connect Cloudflare and Google Analytics for visibility and performance insights

• Manage multiple companies, brands, and client profiles from a single workspace

AuthorityPrompt is designed for businesses, agencies, consultants, SaaS companies, startups, and enterprise teams that want to improve AI understanding, strengthen trusted company information, and maintain an authoritative presence across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Apple Intelligence, and other AI systems.

Whether you are building your first AI-ready company profile or managing AI visibility at scale, AuthorityPrompt provides the infrastructure needed to create trusted company information AI systems can rely on.

plugins.description:
Autocalls lets you build and run AI phone agents — and now you can do it straight from ChatGPT, without switching to a dashboard. Describe what you want, and your assistant takes it from there.

Build and refine assistants by chat: set the prompt, voice, language, model and call behaviour for both inbound agents (answer calls, take bookings, qualify leads) and outbound agents (follow-ups, reminders, lead qualification). Give them real abilities by attaching mid-call tools that call your APIs live during a conversation, and knowledgebases that ground their answers in your own documents.

Run outbound work at scale: create a campaign, add your leads, and start, pause or resume it whenever you like. Then close the loop — list your calls, open any one to read its full transcript and post-call evaluation, and update the assistant or its tools to fix what went wrong, all in the same conversation.

Manage the rest of your account too: knowledgebases and documents, phone numbers and SIP trunks, WhatsApp senders and templates, conversations, folders, labels and API keys.

You stay in control. Every tool works only on your own account, reading and writing are separate actions, anything that spends balance or deletes data is clearly marked, and your stored secrets are masked. You connect once with a secure sign-in — no API keys pasted into the chat.

plugins.description:
The Autodesk® Product Help Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server connects AI agents directly to Autodesk’s official product documentation across 110+ products including Autodesk Fusion®, AutoCAD®, Revit®, Inventor®, Maya®, Civil 3D®, and more. - Ask support questions using natural language.
- Learn and onboard to Autodesk products faster.
- Create a foundation for AI agents and automation.

Requirements:
No special requirements.

The world's designers, engineers, builders, and creators trust Autodesk to help them design and make anything. From the buildings we live and work in, to the cars we drive and the bridges we drive over. From the products we use and rely on, to the movies and games that inspire us. Autodesk's Design and Make Platform unlocks the power of data to accelerate insights and automate processes, empowering our customers with the technology to create the world around us and deliver better outcomes for their business and the planet. plugins.description:
Autumn lets hotel operators ask about their property's performance, pricing, bookings, and marketing — and get answers straight from their own data.

Once you connect your Autumn account, you can ask things like:
- "How is occupancy for next month compared to last year?"
- "What are my ADR and RevPAR this quarter?"
- "Which room types look underpriced right now?"
- "Who were my top-spending guests last month?"
- "How did my Google Ads perform last week?"

Autumn pulls live data from your property management system (Mews, Cloudbeds, or ResNexus), your rate plans, your Google Ads account, and review sites like Google, Booking.com, and Expedia — so the answers reflect what's actually happening at your property today.

All tools are read-only. Autumn does not change rates, modify bookings, or write anything back to your PMS.

Requires an active Autumn subscription. You'll authorize access to your Autumn workspace via OAuth on first use.

plugins.description:
One-stop AI slide app: create, edit, and export slides as videos with voice-overs, all in one place.
Quickly turn any topic, text, PDF, or URL into a professionally designed PowerPoint presentation. With AI-powered content generation, you can edit every detail through conversation and export your work as an editable PPTX or a video with voiceover. 

Key Features
- Multi-source input: Create presentations from a simple topic, pasted text, an uploaded PDF, or a web URL.
- Automated slide design: The AI builds layouts, selects relevant images, and creates diagrams automatically.
- Conversational editing: Refine slides using natural commands to change the tone, shorten text, or add new sections.
- Precision control: Edit any text manually or ask the AI to revise it. Use your own images or generate new AI visuals.
- Export and share: Download a fully editable .pptx file or export your presentation as a video with embedded narration.

How to Use
1. Connect the Awesome Slides app
2. Type "@" and choose the AI Slides app, or type "AI Slides", then enter your prompt

Examples:
- Awesome Slides create a presentation about the history of AI
- Awesome Slides turn this PDF into a 10-slide deck
- Awesome Slides help me make a presentation for my Q3 marketing strategy

plugins.name: app-6a79a62ffec081918338dda668ace8d8
plugins.description:
Beamtrace is an AI visibility platform covering your visibility metrics, prompt tracking, website optimization, and reputation management in AI search. It's built to show how your business holds up when people turn to AI for recommendations.

The app puts your data into a conversation ChatGPT can work with: cross-reference numbers, explain what's behind a drop, and turn scores into something you can act on or hand off.

What you can do with it
#1 Spot the pattern behind your visibility
- "Why don't AI assistants recommend my business?" 
Reads across every prompt you're missing from and names what they have in common.

#2 Find your competitor's edge
- "Why did my competitor jump ahead this month?"
Pulls the competitor leaderboard, then narrows it to what they did or what changed to cause it.

#3 Prioritize your next content fix
- "I can fix only one thing this month, what should I do?”
Ranks your content improvements by impact rather than listing every gap flat, so you know exactly where to start and what to do.

#4 Understand what moved your score
- "What changed in my AI visibility this month?" 
Checks the score trend against the topic and prompt movement to tell you whether it's a real shift.

#5 Build a client-ready report
- "Build this month's AI visibility summary for my client" 
Draws the score, competitor standing, and top fixes, and writes it up as a report that you can paste anywhere.

#6 Know what a metric actually means
- "What does [metric] mean for my visibility, and should I care about it?"
Explains what a metric measures or gives a read on your visibility state in simple words.

How to get started
- Sign in with a Beamtrace account.
- The app reads live data from your connected website.
- No setup beyond that; start the conversation.

Ask a question in plain language and get an analysis scoped to your business.

Requirements
Your business needs an active subscription or trial. A website must be connected to the service. If it isn't, ChatGPT points you to Beamtrace's setup page instead of guessing at your data. 

It doesn't change your Beamtrace settings, tracked prompts, or account data. It reads your dashboard and hands the numbers to ChatGPT for analysis, reporting, and Q&A.

BROSH MCP brings your CRM, sales, marketing, projects, documents, and business operations directly into AI assistants through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Instead of switching between applications, AI agents can securely access, analyze, update, manage settings, and automate workflows using live data from your BROSH workspace.

Designed for sales teams, consultants, service providers, agencies, and growing businesses, BROSH MCP enables AI to work with real business context—including leads, contacts, opportunities, projects, tasks, invoices, contracts, support tickets, and marketing activities. Users can ask questions in natural language, generate insights, automate repetitive processes, and execute CRM actions directly from their AI environment.

Key capabilities include:

Secure MCP-based access to CRM and business data
AI-powered querying, reporting, and data analysis
Lead, contact, account, and opportunity management
Project, task, and workflow automation
Marketing automation and customer engagement workflows
Document generation, e-signatures, quotes, and invoicing
Custom business objects, fields, dashboards, and reporting
Real-time interaction between AI agents and operational systems

BROSH MCP transforms AI assistants from simple chat interfaces into business operators capable of understanding your organization, retrieving information, updating records, and helping teams move faster with less manual work. Built on the open MCP standard, it provides a secure bridge between AI and the systems your business relies on every day.

plugins.name: carsleuth
plugins.description:
Do not buy the badge—investigate the exact car. CarSleuth turns a listing URL, screenshot, VIN, vehicle-history report, or pasted vehicle details into an elegant, evidence-led buyer report.

It resolves the exact engine, transmission, battery, and drivetrain before judging reliability; maps costly failure modes; places the vehicle on its mileage-specific maintenance timeline; checks public VIN, recall, auction, accident, title, and listing clues; and examines repairability, fuel requirements, driving dynamics, ownership exposure, local value, and dealership transaction risk.

Standard and Deep investigations produce responsive self-contained HTML reports with a verdict card, score ring, value metrics, dealership grade, evidence tags, risk cards, cost tables, score bars, inspection priorities, negotiation guidance, and linked sources. A deterministic renderer owns the design, keeping generation fast and token-efficient. Rapid scans remain concise in chat.

CarSleuth keeps verified facts, recurring patterns, anecdotes, seller claims, and unknowns separate. It never treats a public VIN search as CARFAX, missing records as a clean history, or brand reputation as proof that a specific car is reliable.

Research-based decision support only. It does not replace an independent mechanical inspection or official ownership, title, lien, recall, insurance, and registration checks.

Ask questions in plain English and get analyst-grade answers built on near-real-time spend data from millions of US credit and debit cards, covering thousands of brands and merchants — weeks ahead of company reporting. Work directly with transaction-level data to build custom cohorts, run price-point analyses, and answer questions aggregates can't.

Each question runs through Cosmos, Consumer Edge's AI analytics engine, which selects the right metrics, handles panel weighting and merchant hierarchies, and returns a structured summary with the underlying data. Results come back as queryable tables, so ChatGPT can run follow-up analysis, calculate custom metrics, or build charts without re-querying.

Flexible time grains — daily, monthly, or quarterly trends, including quarter-to-date reads on partial periods

Analyst-ready output — answers flag accelerations, decelerations, calendar shifts, and partial-month caveats automatically

Use it to:

Track brand performance ahead of earnings — monthly and quarter-to-date spend growth versus prior periods

Run competitive benchmarking — compare KPIs and market share shifts across any set of brands

Analyze customer behavior — see where new customer growth comes from and whether cohorts are trading down

Spot inflection points — decompose month-over-month changes into customer count, frequency, and ticket drivers

Requires a Consumer Edge subscription with MCP access enabled.

plugins.description:
A complete legal research and firm-management toolkit inside ChatGPT.

Connect ChatGPT to CiteLaw’s U.S. legal database of millions of court opinions, statutes, regulations, court rules, standing orders, agency materials, and other legal authorities. ChatGPT retrieves CiteLaw’s source text instead of relying solely on model memory, producing answers grounded in identifiable authorities with direct citation links.

Legal research:
Ask legal questions in plain English and search cases, statutes, regulations, and rules across jurisdictions. Run Boolean, exact-phrase, metadata, and keyword searches. Retrieve an authority’s text and metadata, investigate how later courts have treated a case, and review a judge’s standing orders and practices. Paste a brief or citation list to verify authorities and identify possible, missing, or mismatched citations. Search documents and revisit prior research stored in your CiteLaw matters.

Firm management:
Review clients, contacts, tasks, deadlines, notes, documents, discovery, clauses, matters, saved workflows, team members, invitations, and workspace activity. Create and update leads, contacts, tasks, calendar events, discovery sets, clauses, matters, team workspaces, and reusable workflows. Run saved workflows in ChatGPT to follow your firm’s standardized research, review, and document processes. Use AI-assisted bulk imports to migrate contacts, matters, leads, tasks, deadlines, and notes from an existing case-management system in batches of 50, with source IDs that make reruns safe. Invite colleagues, manage workspace and matter access, assign roles, and set billing rates. Save notes and drafted Word documents to the active matter. Switch workspaces and matters so work remains in the correct team context.

Built for attorneys, law students, and legal scholars. CiteLaw retrieves and explains legal information; it does not provide legal advice, and using it does not create an attorney-client relationship.

plugins.description:
Manage, search, and transform your Cloudinary media library — directly from Codex.

The Cloudinary app connects your Cloudinary account to Codex, giving you full control over your visual assets through natural language. Upload, organize, tag, transform, and analyze images or videos without leaving the chat. 

What You Can Do
- Upload assets from URLs, local files, or base64 data — automatically analyze, tag, or moderate them.
- Browse and search your entire media library using smart filters or text queries (tags, format, date, size, etc.).
- Organize your library — create folders, rename files, manage metadata, and clean up obsolete assets.

plugins.description:
Collecte MTL tells you when your waste is collected anywhere on the island of Montréal. Enter an address and get the pickup schedule for every stream — garbage, recycling, food and organic waste, green waste, and bulky items — including the next upcoming collection dates for that exact sector.

It can also point you to the nearest écocentres (drop-off centres) for materials that aren't picked up curbside, and show your borough's waste recovery and diversion rates.

The data comes straight from the City of Montréal's official open data (Secteurs Info-collectes), refreshed about once a month. Collecte MTL is a free, independent tool — not affiliated with the City of Montréal — and stores no personal information: an address is used only to look up its collection sector.

plugins.description:
Analyze multi-channel marketing, financial, sales, e-commerce, and other business data within Codex by connecting to your Coupler.io data flows. Fetch and transform raw data from platforms like Google Ads, Facebook, HubSpot, and Salesforce into actionable intelligence for smarter, faster decision-making with accurate, up-to-date business information.

You can use the Coupler.io connector to:

1. Analyze customer acquisition costs: "What's our overall customer acquisition cost across all paid channels this quarter compared to last quarter? I need this for the board meeting"
2. Review marketing ROI: "Show me the ROI breakdown by marketing channel for the past 6 months. I need to reallocate our annual budget"
3. Identify high-performing campaigns:"Which campaigns are contributing most to our pipeline revenue? I want to double down on what's working"
4. Review sales pipeline: "Can you pull the sales pipeline report for this month? I need to see how many deals are in each stage and the total value at each stage"
5. Analyze conversion rates: "What are our conversion rates from lead to opportunity and from opportunity to closed-won for the last quarter? How do they compare to our targets?"
6. Forecast revenue: "How many deals are expected to close this month based on their probability scores? What's our forecasted revenue vs our monthly target?"
7. Compare quarterly profits: "Check the profit for this quarter, compare it to last quarter, and provide a breakdown by department"
8. Generate cash flow reports: "Could you provide a cash flow report for the last 30 days, including all incoming and outgoing transactions?"
9. Review accounts receivable: "Share the current accounts receivable status and tell me how many overdue invoices we have and which customers owe the most"

Crunchbase is the leading provider of private-company prospecting and research data, used by salespeople, entrepreneurs, investors, and market researchers to find and evaluate companies.

This connector brings that data into your conversation. Ask in plain language and get structured answers back.

Predictions
Crunchbase models what a company is likely to do next: raise funding, get acquired, go public, grow, stay private, shut down, or cut headcount, along with an estimated current valuation. Each prediction comes with a confidence tier, so you can sort a market by likelihood rather than reading profiles one at a time.

Insights
Written summaries of what's happening at a company right now, covering growth trajectory, recent news, R&D activity, personnel changes, investor activity, and market position.

Company, funding, and people data
Profiles with descriptions, headcount, revenue range, location, and industry. Full funding round history with amounts, dates, types, and investors. Acquisitions, IPOs, funds, and investments. Founders, executives, and leadership changes. Similar-company matching, plus  many more signals.

Build lists you can return to
Save companies as you find them, so a search you run today becomes a pipeline you can monitor over time.

Requires a Crunchbase account. Available data depends on your subscription tier.

plugins.name: dnb-finance-analytics
plugins.description:
Enable AI-powered credit decisioning, portfolio monitoring, and risk management workflows using trusted D&B data and analytics. 

For inquiries, please contact OpenAILeads@dnb.com

D&B Finance Analytics empowers finance and credit teams to verify businesses, evaluate financial and predictive risk, accelerate credit decisions, monitor portfolio health, and take action through AI assistants, agents, and enterprise applications. By combining trusted D&B business intelligence, financial risk insights, predictive analytics, and workflow capabilities, organizations can bring credit and portfolio management processes directly into AI-driven workflows. 

Anchored by the global standard D‑U‑N‑S® Number and powered by the D&B Commercial Graph™, D&B Finance Analytics helps organizations reduce ambiguity, improve consistency, and make more confident commercial credit decisions at scale. It also enables teams to move from insight to action through portfolio management and workflow capabilities available within D&B Finance Analytics. 

Use D&B Finance Analytics to: 

Evaluate credit recommendation: 
"What is the recommended credit limit for [Company Name], and what factors contributed to that recommendation?" 

Assess business risk: 
"Summarize the financial risk, payment behavior, and predictive risk indicators for [Company Name]." 

Monitor portfolio health: 
"Which customers in my portfolio show elevated risk or signs of deterioration?" 

Prioritize risk management activities: 
"Which customers should I review first based on recent alerts, exposure, and risk changes?" 

Analyze ownership and corporate linkage: 
"Show the ownership structure and related entities for [Company Name]." 

Take action on portfolio: 
"Create a folder named [Folder Name], move [Company Name] to the folder and assign Alert Profile [Alert Profile Name] to the folder." 

Note: Requires a D&B Finance Analytics license.

Whether you're evaluating cars, comparing job offers, choosing a vendor, or weighing any set of alternatives, decisionpoint.io guides you through the process step by step. You define the goal, identify the factors that matter, list your options, and then compare them two at a time. AHP derives ranked results from your comparisons, showing which option best matches your priorities and why.

The app provides:

- An interactive comparison interface within the conversation
- Ranked results with scores and criteria weights
- Consistency analysis to identify contradictory judgments

Decisions are saved to your decisionpoint.io account and can be revisited, refined, or continued at any time.

plugins.description:
Deep Art AI enables users to create high-quality visual content directly through ChatGPT using natural-language instructions. Users can generate entirely new images and videos from text prompts by describing the desired subject, visual style, composition, atmosphere, movement, or other creative details.

Deep Art AI is designed to make use of the latest and most advanced image-generation and video-generation technologies available. The underlying imaging and video capabilities are continuously kept up to date so that users can benefit from current state-of-the-art models, improved visual quality, more accurate prompt understanding, better consistency, enhanced realism, and the latest creative generation capabilities.

For video creation, Deep Art AI can submit video generation requests as asynchronous generation jobs. This allows users to initiate more complex video-generation tasks without requiring the entire generation process to be completed within a single interaction. After a video job has been submitted, users can retrieve its current generation status through ChatGPT, making it possible to check whether the video is still being processed, has been successfully completed, or requires further action.

Overall, Deep Art AI provides an integrated creative workflow within ChatGPT for generating images and videos, submitting video-generation jobs, and monitoring the progress and status of generated video content. By continuously leveraging the latest available imaging and video technologies, Deep Art AI gives users access to modern, high-quality visual creation capabilities through simple conversational, prompt-based interactions.

plugins.description:
Demandbase integration with ChatGPT and Codex gives sales, marketing, and GTM teams seamless access to rich B2B data directly within ChatGPT and Codex for faster account research, prospecting, and engagement.

This app connects ChatGPT and Codex to Demandbase via a secure MCP connection, giving you access to both first-party and third-party data.

Third-Party Data (3P): Search and retrieve industry-leading company and contact data from Demandbase, including firmographics, technographics, family trees, company news, and leadership profiles.

First-Party Data (1P): Securely access your organization's Demandbase data, including known accounts, contacts, CRM entities, engagement, in-flight opportunities, intent signals, and buying-group data.

Account Brief: Generate a single, consolidated account overview combining engagement state, opportunities, buying-group coverage, intent signals, company profile, and recent news in a single request.

What you can do
Search companies by name, location, size, revenue, or industry
Discover decision-makers and influencers by role or job level
Fetch full company profiles, including recent news and competitors
Tap into 1P signals such as engagement, MQA status, and account activity
Identify buying intent on specific topics or keyword sets over time
Find net-new buying-group contacts that aren't already in your CRM
Pull a complete account brief in a single request for fast meeting preparation

Who it's for
Sales reps looking for fast answers about target accounts in real time
Marketing teams enriching leads and refining personas
RevOps and Enablement teams embedding GTM intelligence into workflows
AI product teams building agent-powered workflows

Availability

This integration is available to Demandbase customers with the appropriate Demandbase licenses and entitlements.

To request access, please contact your Demandbase Customer Success Manager (CSM).

For technical support, contact support@demandbase.com.

plugins.description:
Dijin is the **Memory Layer** for your digital life and AI agents — an open, owner-signed, cite-or-refuse store of your decisions, action items, entities, and evidence citations.

Connect this MCP server to ChatGPT and ask it to recall what you've decided on a project, who moved a discussion forward, what your last release shipped, or any other signal Dijin has already captured (from GitHub, Slack, Teams, your own typed Add Memory entries, and more). ChatGPT calls `search` to discover records, then `fetch` for the signed `EvidencePack` — every answer comes back as Ed25519-signed proof with sources and a `/api/verify` link. Never a guess.

Dijin is read-only on the OpenAI side. The MCP server does not expose `memory.write` to ChatGPT; all writes happen on Dijin's own surfaces, behind the user's own login.

plugins.description:
Write a clear, engaging description that highlights what your plugin does and why people will love it. Focus on concrete user value and avoid exaggerative, misleading claims. This will appear publicly on your plugin’s directory page.
Connect ChatGPT directly to your Docs, so drafting and revising documents happens in the same place as the rest of your work: no copying text back and forth between a chat window and a browser tab.

Ask for a document by name and it searches your Drive to find it, then reads the contents back as clean markdown you can quote, summarize, translate or rework. Ask for something new and it creates the document and writes the first draft. From there you get real editing, not just appending: insert and replace text anywhere in the document, replace every occurrence of a phrase in one pass, restyle paragraphs and individual runs of text, and turn lists into proper bullets or strip them back out.

Tables are fully supported: create them, add or remove rows and columns, merge cells, style rows and cells, and pin header rows so they repeat across pages. So is the document furniture most tools skip: headers, footers, footnotes, page and section breaks, page layout settings, inline images, dates and people chips.

Every edit starts by inspecting the document's actual structure, so changes land in the right place instead of clobbering the surrounding text, and related changes are applied together as a single batch rather than one risky rewrite. Word files in your Drive work too: .docx is converted so it can be read and
edited like anything else.

It fits naturally into recurring document work: updating status reports, filling out templates, cleaning up formatting across a long file, and reworking a draft someone else started.

plugins.description:
You already have a life. Build the one you want.

DREAMHALL is a private, structured self-care workspace for thinking through personal questions whose answers should remain your own. Instead of generating conclusions, it guides you through a complete process where you examine your life as a whole, develop your own answers, and turn them into grounded decisions and practical action.

The Framework consists of 15 connected exercises that help you understand what truly matters to you, review the balance of your life, separate your own wishes from outside expectations, clarify the future you want to build, work through fears and obstacles, and define realistic next steps.

Unlike an open-ended conversation, DREAMHALL is designed as a finite process with a clear beginning, a deliberate sequence, and a meaningful ending. Every answer is written by you. Every conclusion is your own. The result is a Personal Document that brings together your reflections, priorities, decisions, and next steps in one place.

Your private answers remain inside DREAMHALL and are not returned to ChatGPT through this integration.

When you finish, you can keep your Personal Document in DREAMHALL, download it as a PDF, or export it as Markdown. If you choose, you can later use your own document with ChatGPT to organize ideas, develop plans, compare future versions, or expand it into longer writing. You decide what to share and when.

DREAMHALL supports reflective thinking, life balance, personal wellbeing, and self-directed decision-making. It is a non-clinical self-care product and is not therapy, diagnosis, medical care, emergency support, or crisis support.

Some of the most important decisions should remain your own.

plugins.description:
Duckhub QR Menu is restaurant software that digitizes dining with QR code menus and integrated ordering. Diners scan codes to view digital menus on their phones without apps or paper. An AI assistant generates dish descriptions, translates menus into 14 languages, and creates item images. Reservations are managed via the menu or apps like WhatsApp, with confirmations handled through a dashboard. Online ordering lets restaurants create websites with menus and ordering features. Table ordering allows diners to scan QR codes, select items, and send orders to the kitchen with table identification. Delivery management and staff access controls are included. Analytics track trends and peak hours, while customization options include templates, fonts, and logos. Smart promotions automate discounts based on times or days.

With this plugin, a restaurant owner connects their Duckhub venue to ChatGPT and manages it by conversation: read the current draft menu, create or edit categories, dishes, prices, ingredients and option groups, upload dish photos, translate the menu into any enabled language, adjust venue info, working hours, design and ordering settings, manage tables and their QR links, run promotions and banners, then publish the menu live (or roll a bad publish back). Paid plans can also read guest orders and move them through their lifecycle. Every change is scoped to the single venue the owner authorized, is written to a draft first, and only becomes visible to guests after an explicit publish.

plugins.description:
Der ecoExperten-Connector bringt den deutschen Energieausweis in den KI-Chat. Wer eine Wohnimmobilie vermieten oder verkaufen will, braucht gesetzlich einen Energieausweis — mit dieser App lässt er sich vollständig im Gespräch bestellen:

1. Beraten: Die App erklärt, welcher Ausweistyp passt und welche Angaben nötig sind (Gebäudedaten plus drei aufeinanderfolgende Jahres-Heizabrechnungen).
2. Prüfen: Alle Angaben werden vorab kostenlos gegen die gesetzlichen Regeln des Gebäudeenergiegesetzes (GEG) validiert — z. B. 18-Monats-Frist der Verbrauchsdaten, Bedarfsausweis-Pflicht nach § 80 Abs. 3, Leerstandsgrenzen — ohne dass eine Bestellung ausgelöst wird.
3. Bestellen: Nach ausdrücklicher Zustimmung zu AGB und zahlungspflichtiger Bestellung legt die App eine schwebende Bestellung an und sendet einen Bestätigungslink an die angegebene E-Mail-Adresse. Erst der Klick auf diesen Link macht die Bestellung verbindlich; unbestätigte Bestellungen verfallen nach 48 Stunden automatisch. Kauf auf Rechnung, kein Zahlungsvorgang im Chat. Ein Doppelbestellungs-Schutz verhindert versehentliche Mehrfachkäufe.
4. Verfolgen: Der Bearbeitungsstand ist über Bestellnummer plus die bei der Bestellung angegebene E-Mail-Adresse abrufbar; die Antwort enthält nur den Bearbeitungsstand, keine Personen- oder Gebäudedaten.

Die Ausstellung erfolgt durch eingetragene Energieberater des CO5 Ingenieurbüros für nachhaltiges Bauen (PartG mbB, Berlin); jeder Ausweis erhält eine amtliche DIBt-Registriernummer und wird in der Regel innerhalb von 1–2 Werktagen als PDF per E-Mail zugestellt. Preis: 59 € brutto (Verbrauchsausweis); der Bedarfsausweis (119 €) ist über das Web-Formular erhältlich.

plugins.description:
ExpenseBot turns ChatGPT into a full expense-management workflow for freelancers, accountants, real-estate agents, and small business owners.

Drop a receipt photo or PDF in chat and AI extracts vendor, amount, date, tax, and category, then writes the row to your Google Sheet within 30 seconds. Ask "how much did I spend on travel last quarter, broken down by client" and get a per-tag P&L with revenue, cost, profit, and margin. Build a Q1 expense report and have ChatGPT email it to your accountant.

Tools fall into scope-gated categories the user explicitly approves during the OAuth consent flow: read expenses, submit expenses (photos, PDFs, cash, mileage, income), scan Gmail for missed receipts, read reports, write reports, and run compliance and tax-deductibility checks.

While ExpenseBot can scan Gmail (with the user's explicit OAuth consent), Gmail is one of many input paths. The app's primary value is the analytics, reporting, and tax tooling that operates on the user's own categorized expense data.

The ChatGPT app does not sell anything and processes no payment. It manages the user's own expense data. An ExpenseBot account is required; new users can create one for free at expensebot.ai before connecting.

OAuth 2.1 + PKCE S256 + Dynamic Client Registration. CASA Tier 2 certified.

plugins.description:
Forms are easy to need and annoying to build. Every question type, every section break, every setting is another click - and by the time responses arrive, reading them is its own chore. This plugin moves all of it into the conversation.

Build a form by describing it. Say what you're collecting — a customer satisfaction survey, an event signup, a job application screener, a 20-point quiz for your class — and it's created in your account, with sensible question types chosen for you: multiple choice where the answers are known, scales for ratings, short text where they aren't, required fields where they matter.

Keep editing in plain language. Add a question in the middle. Reword the confusing one. Move it to page two. Make question 4 worth double. Drop the one nobody answers. Every change lands on the live form — no rebuilding from scratch, no digging through the editor to find the right toggle.

Set it up properly, without hunting for settings. Turn a form into a graded quiz, collect email addresses, limit it to one response per person, open or close it to responses - all by asking.

Then actually read the results. Find any of your forms by name, pull the responses, and ask real questions of them: What's the overall sentiment? What are the three most common complaints in the open-text box? How did answers differ between the two groups? Free-text feedback - the part that usually goes unread because summarizing 200 answers by hand isn't happening - gets read and summarized for you.

Works with the forms you already own, not just new ones.

plugins.description:
Fraghab is a fragrance collection manager. It tracks the bottles and decants you own, how much is left in each, what you wore and when, and what you are saving up for.

Connect it and you can work with your own shelf in plain language. Ask what you have not worn since spring and it reads your collection. Say you wore the Santal 33 decant today, four sprays, and it logs the wearing and deducts the millilitres. Add a bottle you just bought in a sentence instead of a form, correct a rating or a note on one you already have, group bottles onto shelves, and save the layering combos you actually wear.

It also prices your wishlist. Ask for the best price on something you are saving for and Fraghab searches fragrance retailers for the cheapest current offer, tells you which shop has it, and gives the entry a product photo.

You authorize the connection on a Fraghab screen and approve each permission. Nothing can be deleted through it. Editing replaces what was there, so ChatGPT asks before it changes something you already had. Changing your Fraghab password revokes access immediately. Fraghab is free and takes no payment of any kind.

plugins.description:
Genesys gives your AI a causal memory graph — not a list of remembered facts, but a living network where every memory is a node, every relationship is a typed causal edge, and every retrieval can be explained. Ask why a memory surfaced and Genesys shows its relevance score, causal connectivity, and reactivation history. Trace how memories connect and follow full causal chains from decision to consequence.

Your memory graph is yours: it lives outside any single AI vendor, works identically with ChatGPT, Claude, and any MCP-compatible model, and travels with you when you switch. You control it directly — pin what matters permanently, inspect graph health at any time, and delete anything, anytime, with hard erasure.

Built on neuroscience-inspired scoring (relevance × causal connectivity × reactivation), Genesys forgets safely: only memories that are irrelevant, causally orphaned, and unpinned are ever pruned.

Your memory graph is yours: it lives outside any single AI vendor, works identically with ChatGPT, Claude, and any MCP-compatible model, and travels with you when you switch. You control it directly — pin what matters permanently, inspect graph health at any time, and delete anything, anytime, with hard erasure.

Built on neuroscience-inspired scoring (relevance × causal connectivity × reactivation), Genesys forgets safely: only memories that are irrelevant, causally orphaned, and unpinned are ever pruned.

plugins.description:
GovQuery is a powerful search engine that makes U.S. government reports and data easier to explore, locate, and understand.
 
Built by the Program Integrity Alliance, GovQuery processes over 300,000 articles, reports, and oversight recommendations to make them more digestible for AI platforms — offering deeper, more targeted search than general-purpose engines. Every result links to the exact page where content appears, and you can filter by granular categories unavailable on the source platforms.
 
Data sources currently include:
 
- Reports from the Government Accountability Office (GAO), federal inspectors general (Oversight.gov), and the Congressional Research Service (CRS)
- Department of Justice press releases
- Executive orders (last six presidents)
- Annual federal CJ/AFR/PAR agency reports (since 2019 for Chief Financial Officers (CFO) Act of 1990)
 
GovQuery also includes all open oversight recommendations from the GAO and federal inspectors general (Oversight.gov), with tools to analyze them by category and track trends over time.
 
New data sources are added regularly.
 
You can register for a free account at: https://www.programintegrity.org (click on the person icon top-right)

For more information on GovQuery data, please see our FAQ (https://www.programintegrity.org/faq).

Your AI assistant can search your Granola meetings by topic, person, company, or timeframe - then cite specific conversations in its responses. No more switching tabs to find "what the customer said" or "when we decided that."

plugins.description:
Meet Hero, your AI teammate for Sales. Hero can join your calls, write your follow-ups, research accounts, and help you keep every deal moving. This connector provides ChatGPT read-only access to your Hero data so you can get Hero’s insights wherever you work best. 

What you can do in ChatGPT with the Hero connector
• Search meeting transcripts by keyword, meaning, date range, or workspace to  pull the full transcript with per-speaker segments.
• Find and read Hero-generated artifacts like call summaries, account research, saved notes, and uploaded files.
• Browse and revisit your Hero conversation threads.
• Get a list of your Workspaces (accounts and deals) to scope your work. 

Example prompts
• “Summarize my calls with Acme this month, and draft a follow-up email.”
• “Can you tell me what objections came up during yesterday’s demo with Hooli?” 
• “Pull the account research Hero wrote for Globex and turn it into a one-pager.”
• “Find every call where pricing came up this quarter.”

Security and Privacy
• Sign in with secure OAuth: no passwords or API keys to manage.
• Strictly read-only: ChatGPT can retrieve your Hero data but cannot create, modify, or delete anything.
• Scoped to your own account: ChatGPT only sees data you already have access to in Hero
• Requires a Hero account: get started at meethero.ai.

plugins.description:
Homesage.ai turns ChatGPT into a real estate analyst with investor-grade data on 155M+ US residential properties. Connect once, then ask in plain language for valuations, comparable sales, rental and flip returns, renovation costs, owner details, and Full Property Reports. No spreadsheets or manual data pulls.

Ask about any US residential address and get property investment metrics, an automated valuation (AVM), comparable sales with after-repair value (ARV), and an AI-assessed property condition, including analysis of listing photos or your own images. The Price Flexibility Score, a Homesage.ai signature signal, predicts how negotiable a seller really is.

For investors, Homesage.ai projects fix-and-flip returns, renovation costs with room-by-room breakdowns, and both long-term and short-term rental economics such as cash flow, cap rate, NOI, and cash-on-cash return.

Screen entire markets with ZIP-level sold data and Market Outlook scores, or search the national property database with investor filters for price, condition, equity, distress signals, and more.

Additional tools cover solar potential and AI roof analysis, mortgage and lien records, pre-foreclosure status, location risk flags, and owner skip-tracing for outreach.

Most analytics tools consume credits from your Homesage.ai account, and each tool's credit cost is listed in its description. The property database search always previews the result count and cost for free before charging.

Homesage.ai reads property data and returns analysis. It does not modify your account, move funds, or take actions on your behalf. Coverage is US residential properties only, and comparable-sale and ARV data is limited in non-disclosure states where sale prices aren't public.

plugins.description:
Search, compare, and book airport transfers, airport taxis, ride-hailing, shuttles and ski transfers across Europe, the Americas, Asia, Oceania, and Africa.

@hoppa is a global mobility platform offering seamless door-to-door ground transportation across 182+ countries, 2,600+ airports, and thousands of resorts. We empower 40 million+ customers to instantly compare and book the best fares for airport transfers, private taxis, ride-hailing, and shared shuttles in one place.

With real-time access to a network of 70,000+ vetted local providers, @hoppa ensures reliable fixed-price travel tailored to every journey and budget. Trusted by the world’s leading payment networks, including Mastercard, Visa, UnionPay, and Alipay, we simplify last-mile travel for every traveller.
How to use @hoppa: Ask the @hoppa app to compare routes or find the most cost-effective way to reach your destination. You can filter by vehicle type, price, or travel time to ensure your arrival is as smooth as your flight.

Key Features:
1: Compare & Save: Instant access to private transfers, shared shuttles, and taxis.
2: Global Reach: Coverage in 182+ countries and 2,600+ airports.
3: Fixed Pricing: No hidden fees; know what you pay before you book.
4: Vetted Providers: 70,000+ reliable local fleets.

Useful for:
1: Planning stress-free transport before you land.
2: Comparing ride-hailing vs private transfers in real-time.
3: Securing reliable transport for large groups or solo holiday travel.

Conversation Starters (Try asking)
“@hoppa, find a private transfer from Barcelona Airport to the City Centre.”
“@hoppa, what are the cheapest shuttle options from Malaga Airport?”
“@hoppa, book a taxi from Heathrow to Central London for 4 people.”
“@hoppa, show me airport transportation options in Miami airport.”

plugins.description:
Inkbox gives an AI assistant its own communication identity: an email address, a phone number, SMS and iMessage, and voice calls, reachable by humans and other agents alike. The assistant reads and sends from its own inbox, handles its own calls and texts, and keeps a contact book and notes that carry context between conversations. Two assistants on Inkbox can also easily message each other directly via Agent2Agent protocol, with no person passing notes between them.

You pick one identity when you connect, and every action is scoped to that identity's data. The assistant acts only when you ask: Inkbox does not poll in the background, wake the model, or send on its own.

Phone numbers are currently available in the United States. Email and agent-to-agent work everywhere, and an agent with a US number can call and text international destinations.

plugins.description:
InsightfulPipe is a marketing workspace that connects ChatGPT to the marketing, analytics, SEO, social media, and e-commerce platforms your business already uses. Ask questions in plain language, retrieve live data, create reports, and perform supported actions without manually exporting and combining spreadsheets.

Paid advertising: Connect Google Ads, Meta Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Pinterest Ads, Snapchat Ads, and X Ads. Analyze spend, campaign performance, conversions, and other available metrics. You can also conduct competitor research using supported public advertising libraries.

SEO and site health: Access Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, and DataForSEO for search performance, SERPs, keyword rankings, and backlinks. Additional tools include website crawling, PageSpeed Insights, and Google Tag Manager.

Analytics: Retrieve insights from Google Analytics 4, Microsoft Clarity, CallRail, and YouTube Analytics.

Social media and scheduling: Analyze connected Instagram accounts, Facebook Pages, LinkedIn Pages and profiles, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube, Google Business Profile, and WordPress. Supported connections can also schedule, publish, and reschedule content across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube, Threads, and Google Business Profile.

E-commerce and email: Connect Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, Google Merchant Center, Klaviyo, and Mailchimp.

InsightfulPipe can combine information from normally separate platforms. For example, ask ChatGPT to compare advertising spend with website sessions, conversions, orders, and revenue across your authorized accounts.

You can also connect your own data sources, including BigQuery, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQL Server, with per-connection read-only or full-access permissions. Other supported sources include Airtable, Notion, Google Sheets, and Slack. Custom REST APIs can be connected using supported OpenAPI 3.x specifications.

Read and write capabilities are exposed separately. Read-only tools do not modify connected accounts, while write actions require the necessary permissions and user confirmation. All tools operate within the access granted through each connection.

An InsightfulPipe account with at least one authorized connection is required. Available platforms, data, and actions depend on the services connected by each user and the permissions they grant.

plugins.description: Interestnaut grounds recommendations in what you have actually reacted to and rated — across films, TV, books, games, music, podcasts and creators — instead of guessing from genre labels. ChatGPT can read your reaction history, your 1-10 ratings, and your computed taste profile, and search the catalog by title across all seven media types. Ratings carry the most signal: they are sparse and deliberate, so a 9 means considerably more than a like. Reactions are not interchangeable either — "meh" means you consumed something and felt nothing, while "skipped" means you passed without engaging and carries no opinion at all. With your permission it can also record reactions and ratings, so you can keep your library current without leaving the conversation. Sign-in is OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and a consent screen listing exactly what you are granting, and you can disconnect at any time. Cover art, plot summaries and adult titles are never sent; results come back as links to app.interestnaut.com.

plugins.name: jam
plugins.description:
Jam for ChatGPT connects your Jam screen recordings to ChatGPT. When you paste a Jam link, the app pulls in rich debugging context from that recording, including video, user events, console logs, errors, and network requests. ChatGPT can then use this data to help you understand, fix, and organize product issues.

Use Jam for ChatGPT to:
• Explain what went wrong in a recording and why
• Turn a Jam into an engineering ready bug ticket
• Write test cases based on the exact user steps
• Summarize a customer’s experience and impact
• Group similar Jams into themes or issue clusters
• Plan code changes based on real traces, not guesses

How it works:
1. Record an issue or user session with Jam.
2. Copy the Jam link, for example https://jam.dev/c/UUID.
3. In ChatGPT, paste the Jam URL and ask what you want to do, such as:
        •        “Find the root cause of this bug.”
        •        “Write a Jira ticket from this Jam.”
        •        “List clean reproduction steps from this recording.”
        •        “Group these Jam links into related issues.”

Behind the scenes, the Jam app turns your Jam into structured, machine readable data that ChatGPT can work with. You get deep technical context and clear next steps, without retyping steps or relying on users to copy and paste logs.

If you work in engineering, product, QA, or support, Jam for ChatGPT helps you move from “What happened here?” to “Here is exactly what we need to do next.”

plugins.description:
Kalender Sync connects ChatGPT to all your calendars at once: Google, Microsoft 365 and Outlook, Apple iCloud, GMX, WEB.DE, mailbox.org, kSuite and any other CalDAV service. One connection instead of one per account, which means ChatGPT finally sees your whole schedule and not just one corner of it.

Ask things like:
· "Show me next week across all my accounts, work and private."
· "When do I actually have three free hours next week?"
· "Am I double-booked anywhere? My work and private appointments live in different accounts."
· "Suggest three slots for a client call, with 30 minutes buffer around everything."
· "How many hours are genuinely uncommitted this month?"
· "Summarise last week by client so I can bill it."

It can also write, if you let it. Block two hours of focus time tomorrow morning, put a whole course schedule into your calendar in one go and have the clashes flagged, or move something you created earlier. Anything it added, it can take back out again in a single sentence.

And it works inside whatever else you are doing. Ask it to draft a reply proposing meeting times you are actually free, or tell a project to always check your calendar before it suggests any dates.

You stay in control of what it sees. Per calendar you choose the level of detail: busy only, title and time, or full details. Write access is optional and strictly limited, because ChatGPT can only change or delete events it created itself. Your existing appointments cannot be touched, and you can revoke access at any time.

Calendars are read live from the provider, never from a copy. Every new account starts with a 7-day trial of the full feature set, no credit card required. Built and hosted in Germany, GDPR-compliant, DPA available.

plugins.description:
Kamai is an AI blueprint analysis and construction takeoff platform built for contractors, subcontractors, estimators, and construction teams.

Kamai helps users extract quantities, measurements, materials, rooms, fixtures, and scope information directly from construction drawings and project documents. Contractors can use Kamai to estimate jobs faster, prepare bids, calculate material requirements, answer questions about blueprints, and reduce hours of manual takeoff work.

Kamai supports interior construction and finish trades such as:

* Painting and coatings
* Drywall and sheetrock
* Insulation
* Metal and wood framing
* Flooring
* Ceilings
* Doors, windows, and room measurements

Kamai also supports additional construction trades and building systems, including:

* Electrical
* Plumbing
* Fixtures and equipment
* General construction quantities

Users can upload blueprints and ask questions such as:

* How many square feet of flooring are required?
* How much wall area needs to be painted?
* How many sheets of drywall are needed?
* How much insulation and framing material is required?
* How many doors, sinks, toilets, outlets, or fixtures are shown?
* What materials should be ordered for this project?
* What is included in the project scope?
* Can you generate a takeoff from these drawings?

Kamai converts static construction documents into structured, AI-readable project data that can support estimating, bidding, purchasing, RFIs, cost planning, and project execution.

For contractors who need to review drawings, estimate construction work, order materials, or complete more bids in less time, Kamai provides an AI-powered way to understand project documents and turn blueprint data into actionable quantities.

plugins.description:
Korea Concierge helps people navigate Korean secondhand shopping and practical life tasks from chat. Search Bunjang listings, inspect listing details, calculate an item quote, and create a reviewed purchase request. Every order is reviewed before payment, and the buyer receives a private order page with the quote, payment step, status, proof, and tracking.

The plugin also provides free, deterministic checks based on official Korean apartment transaction data. Users can inspect recent sale and rent records, compare a jeonse deposit with sale prices, or compare a monthly rent offer with similar transactions. These tools provide transaction data and clearly disclosed calculations, not brokerage or advice.

Curated living guides cover arrival administration, housing contracts, banking, property purchase procedure, and schools. Users can also submit a settling, housing-support, or education request for founder review. Korea Concierge operates as the principal seller for secondhand resale orders and as the service provider for accepted concierge engagements.

plugins.description:
Krisp AI Meeting Assistant MCP gives your AI assistant secure access to your meeting history, including transcripts, summaries, action items, and upcoming meetings. It enables your AI to work with real context from your actual conversations.

Put your meetings to work:
Draft documents and proposals using decisions, feedback, and stakeholder input from past meetings. Prepare for upcoming meetings with quick briefs on previous discussions, pending items, and attendees. Track follow ups by surfacing open action items across all meetings, filtered by assignee, status, or date. Search for specific moments by topic, attendee, keyword, or date range. Build presentations and reports by combining insights from multiple conversations in one place.
How it works:
Your AI assistant searches and retrieves information from your Krisp meetings in real time. Ask in plain language, such as “What did we decide about pricing last week?” or “Show my open action items,” and get answers grounded in what was actually discussed. Full transcripts are available whenever you need deeper context.
Why it’s different:
Krisp captures complete meeting transcripts with noise cancelled audio clarity, so your AI works from accurate and comprehensive records. Instead of static notes, your meetings become a structured, searchable knowledge base your AI assistant can use whenever you need it.

plugins.description:
Bring your Kuliko study library into the conversation. Connect Kuliko to turn your own documents and notes into active study material — flashcards, summaries, practice quizzes, and mind maps — and review it all without leaving the chat.

Kuliko's methods are built on well-established learning science: spaced repetition and retrieval practice, two of the most studied techniques for moving knowledge into long-term memory. Ask to generate flashcards from a subject, pull up the summary of a document you uploaded, or run through a quiz and get your results. With Kuliko Pro, you can review flashcards on a spaced-repetition schedule that surfaces each card right when you're about to forget it, take full quizzes, and explore concepts visually with mind maps.

Everything stays tied to your Kuliko account, so the subjects, documents, and progress you build here show up in your dashboard too. Whether you're prepping for an exam or just trying to retain what you read, Kuliko keeps your studying grounded in how memory actually works.
