plugins.description:
Lead Recorder shows you where your leads actually came from.

It tracks every phone click, form submission and enquiry on a website and matches each one back to the exact ad, Google search or post that produced it. This plugin lets you ask about that data in plain English instead of opening a dashboard.

Three read-only tools:

List Sites returns the client websites your account can report on.

Get Quiet Sites lists sites with no leads in the last few days. Useful if you manage a lot of client sites and want to catch a problem before the client does.

Get Monthly Report returns the numbers for one site in a given month: total leads, new versus returning visitors, the split between phone clicks, forms and email enquiries, the paid, organic and direct channel breakdown, top sources and campaigns, and the percentage of leads that arrived outside business hours.

Things you can ask:

"Which of my client sites had no leads this week?"
"How did Bob's Plumbing do last month and where did the leads come from?"
"Write this month's lead report for a client using the real numbers."

It's built for marketing agencies and the businesses they work with, particularly local service businesses where the enquiry is a phone call rather than an online checkout.

You'll need a Lead Recorder account with the tracking snippet installed on at least one site. There's a free plan and installation takes about thirty seconds. Nothing in your account can be modified through this plugin.

plugins.description:
Letsfind creates group polls from a description in the chat. Say which dates you want to propose, or which options people should choose between, and you get back a link to share.

There are two kinds of polls. A date poll proposes several days or time slots and asks everyone what works for them, which is the usual way to settle on a meeting, a dinner or a trip. An options poll asks a plain question with answers you define, for picking a restaurant, a name or a plan.

Every poll comes back with two links. The voting link is the one you send to the group; people open it in a browser and answer without creating an account or installing anything. The admin link is yours alone and the only way to edit the poll later, so it is worth keeping.

Once answers come in, you can ask here how the poll is doing instead of opening it yourself. You get the count for each option and the names of the people who picked it.

plugins.description:
LIAM is a personal memory assistant. It saves and recalls the facts, preferences, and notes you want to keep across conversations; stores and searches your contacts; keeps multi-step recipes and routines; and logs your meals and receipts with daily nutrition and spending summaries. You can type a request or just upload a photo — a receipt, a meal, a business card, or a note — and LIAM reads it and files it in the right place automatically (a restaurant receipt is logged as both an expense and a meal). Only extracted text/values are stored, never the raw image.
Example use cases
"Remember I prefer window seats on flights — tag it 'travel'."
"Who do I know at Nova Retail?" / "Add Sarah Chen from Acme as a contact."
"Log my lunch: chicken caesar salad" → "How much protein did I have today?"
"Log this receipt: Loblaws $87.43 groceries" → "How much did I spend today?"
Upload a business-card photo → contact created; upload a receipt photo → expense + meal logged.

plugins.description:
LiftTrack is a strength training app for Garmin users that lets you build custom workouts on your phone, sync them to your Garmin watch, and track your progress over time. It's purpose-built for weightlifters — with features like an unlimited exercise library, superset support, rest timers, RPE logging, warmup calculators, and AI-powered workout creation. If you don't have the app yet, download LiftTrack on iOS or Android at lifttrackapp.com.

Once connected, ChatGPT can access your real workout templates and completed sessions, so you stay in one chat while your data does the work.

Goals you can accomplish

Plan your week — Ask "What did I do last week?" or "What's in my Push template?" and get answers from your actual workouts and templates so ChatGPT can suggest what to do next.

Stay on program — Have ChatGPT remind you what's in a given workout, what weight and sets you did last time, or what you're supposed to do today.

Review and adjust — Ask for summaries by week or month ("How many sessions did I do?" "How did my squat progress?") and use that to adjust volume or intensity.

plugins.description:
Turn any topic into study-ready materials directly from ChatGPT. Lurna helps you generate interactive flashcard decks you can flip through in chat, plus structured Markdown study notes in a clean reader view. Review key concepts faster, then export decks and notes to app.lurna.co to keep learning with spaced repetition — making serious review a native part of your AI-study workflow.

You can use Lurna app to:

1. Exam prep — flashcards from a lecture topic
Use case: Turn a subject you’re studying into an interactive flashcard deck you can review in chat, then export to Lurna for spaced repetition.
Example prompt: “Create flashcards for my biology midterm on photosynthesis — cover the light reactions, Calvin cycle, and how ATP and NADPH are used. About 15 cards, exam-level.”

2. Deep-dive study notes from a conversation
Use case: After discussing a complex topic with AI, turn the explanation into structured, readable study notes with headings, tables, and summaries
Example prompt: “Write study notes on the causes and consequences of the 2008 financial crisis. Include key terms, a timeline, and a short summary I can review before class.”

3. Learn from uploaded materials — notes + flashcards
Use case: Upload readings, slides, or your own notes and convert them into study materials without reformatting by hand.
Example prompt: “Here are my uploaded lecture notes on CRISPR Cas9. First generate study notes, then create a flashcard set covering the most testable concepts.”

4. Quick review before an interview or certification
Use case: Rapidly build recall-focused flashcards for technical interviews, certifications, or vocabulary.
Example prompt: “Generate flashcards to help me prep for a AWS Solutions Architect interview — focus on S3, IAM, VPC, and common architecture tradeoffs.”

plugins.description:
Magic Tips turns "when should we go?" into a concrete answer.

Ask for a resort and a month, and you get a daily crowd score from 1 to 10
with the predicted wait-time level for each date — across Disneyland Paris,
Walt Disney World, Disneyland Resort (California), Tokyo Disney Resort,
Hong Kong Disneyland and Shanghai Disney Resort. Scores are built from
historical wait-time observations, school and public holiday calendars,
weather data and seasonal events, then normalised against each park's own
demand range.

It also answers the questions that come next:
• Attraction catalogues per park — minimum height, ride duration, must-do
  flag and community rating
• Which restaurants serve a given dish, searched across every resort
  ("vegan", "turkey leg", "mickey waffle")
• Resort FAQs and a plain-language glossary of planning jargon (Lightning
  Lane, DAS, rope drop), available in 13 languages

Scope and limits, stated plainly: coverage is Disney parks and Disney
Cruise Line — not Universal. The attraction catalogue is static and does
not include live wait times or ride closures. Crowd scores are forecasts,
not guarantees; the methodology and its known limits are published at
https://magic-tips.app/en/methodology

Magic Tips is an independent, fan-made project. It is not affiliated with,
endorsed by, sponsored by, or officially connected to The Walt Disney
Company or any of its subsidiaries or affiliates. Park, attraction and
character names are trademarks of their respective owners and are used
here only to identify the places this tool covers.

plugins.name: app-6a6cf7506ec88191b19e91e11afe0436
plugins.description:
Magnus is an analytics platform for mobile and web app publishers. It aggregates marketing spend from ad networks, subscription and in-app revenue, ad-network monetization, payment-provider outcomes and first-party product-analytics events into one place, so a publisher can ask how a campaign, an app or an experiment is actually performing.

Over MCP the app exposes that data read-only. Three tools answer questions: marketing_timeline_report for acquisition and monetization performance (installs, spend, revenue, ROMI, forecasts), finances_risk_report and finances_risk_approval_rates for payment risk (approval rate, refunds, fraud alerts, disputes, chargebacks). A second group answers product-analytics questions from the publisher's own SDK events: event counts, funnels, retention, user-property segments and A/B experiment configuration. Everything else is a lookup helper that exists to feed those tools with real ids, filter values and metric definitions, because app ids, event names and metric semantics are account-specific and cannot be guessed.

Access is scoped to the companies the signed-in user is an active member of, and that membership is re-checked on every single call, so the model can never reach another tenant's data. The OAuth scope the app requests, mcp:analytics.read, grants read access only: no tool in the server can create, update or delete anything.

plugins.description:
Moody's Credit MCP powers AI applications and analytics workflows with GenAI-ready data and research needed for comprehensive credit analysis.

Moody's Credit MCP provides a unified layer across core credit data categories commonly used in risk assessment, offering financial analysis, default risk metrics, and qualitative insights. It combines comprehensive entity information, such as financials, ownership, and management, with Moody's Ratings proprietary ratings and research, and probability of default metrics, all enhanced by unstructured data like company filings, earnings transcripts, news, and macroeconomic trends.

By bringing structured and unstructured credit inputs together in a single interface, Moody's Credit MCP enables faster data-to-insight workflows, supporting more rigorous, consistent credit assessment and continuous monitoring of entities, markets, and portfolios.

Data includes:
- Global entity firmographics and identifiers
- Entity hierarchies and ownership structures
- Detailed global entity financials
- Moody's Ratings credit ratings and research
- Expected default frequency
- Economic data and research
- News and media
- Annual reports

Use Moody's Credit MCP for:
- Credit Analysis - access comprehensive credit risk data and research to assess creditworthiness and compare risk across issuers and instruments
- Risk Management - monitor credit risk through forward-looking measures and scenario analysis
- Relationship Management - quickly evaluate credit health to support informed engagement and credit structuring
- Ratings Advisory - align issuer details with ratings methodologies and peer benchmarks
- Investment Research - get data-driven assessments to evaluate relative value and risk
- Market Analysis - analyze sector trends and credit risk signals to assess broader market conditions

plugins.description:
Moody’s Growth & Strategy MCP supports AI-driven sales, marketing, and revenue operations by providing GenAI-ready data, analytics, and insights to inform go-to-market execution. It brings together firmographic, ownership, relationship, and market datasets into a unified intelligence layer to help teams identify opportunities, prioritize accounts, and support more effective customer engagement. 
 
The solution combines comprehensive Moody’s entity intelligence, including global company profiles, hierarchies, and ownership linkages, with augmented signals such as news, market activity, and risk indicators. This integrated view helps organizations gain additional visibility into total addressable markets, identify whitespace opportunities, and align sales and marketing strategies around high-value prospects. 
 
By bringing together structured company data and contextual insights into a single interface, Moody’s Growth & Strategy MCP helps streamline data-to-insight workflows and supports improvements in targeting precision, pipeline quality, and revenue outcomes. 
 
Data includes: 
- Global company firmographics and identifiers 
- Corporate hierarchies and ownership structures 
- Contact and relationship intelligence 
- Industry classifications and segmentation 
- Financial indicators and company scale metrics 
- News, market signals, and company events 
- Risk indicators and early warning signals 
- Economic data and research 

 Use Moody’s Growth & Strategy MCP for: 
- GTM Planning – define and size target markets with comprehensive company coverage  
- Account Prioritization – identify and prioritize high-value prospects and customers and support more sophisticated opportunity scoring by combining company-level data with market-level indicators. 
- Territory Design – support geographic and account planning by highlighting industries, regions or countries with stronger growth prospects 
- Pipeline Acceleration – surface in-market signals and help support timely engagement based on macroeconomic trends, investment activity, hiring trends or sector-level forecasts 
- Cross-Sell & Upsell – help identify whitespace within existing customer portfolios and support AI-generated account briefs that incorporate industry outlooks, economic scenarios, and strategic talking points 
- CRM Enrichment – enrich account and lead records with company data and insights 
- Marketing Segmentation – develop data-driven audience segments using company, market, and relationship insights

plugins.description:
Music Block turns ChatGPT’s music-theory answers into real, engraved sheet music instead of ASCII text.

Ask for licks, scale fingerings, arpeggios, chord voicings or exercises — “give me 5 licks in melodic minor over B7alt”, “show me four ways to resolve B7alt into Em” — and Music Block renders each example as standard notation with guitar tablature underneath, directly in the conversation.

Every example is interactive: press play to hear it (MIDI synthesis with a real instrument sound), slow it down or speed it up from 50% to 150% without changing pitch, switch between examples, and copy the underlying alphaTex source into your own tools.

Music Block understands guitar-specific technique markings: hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, half- and full-step bends, vibrato, palm muting and let-ring, plus time signatures from 4/4 to 12/8, rests, dotted rhythms and chords.

It is built for learning and teaching: short, original musical examples composed by ChatGPT in your conversation. It does not look up or reproduce copyrighted songs or published transcriptions, requires no account, and stores nothing you send it.

Instead of manually browsing stores and negotiating with sellers, users can describe what they want and their budget. Pier39 discovers participating negotiate.v1 merchants, finds matching products, opens negotiations with merchant AI sales agents, and works toward the best possible deal on the user's behalf.

• Discover product catalogs and pricing automatically
• Negotiate discounts, bundles, shipping, warranties, and other concessions

• Summarize negotiated outcomes and savings opportunities
• Help users make more informed purchasing decisions

Pier39 is built on the negotiate.v1 protocol, an open standard that allows AI shopper agents and AI merchant agents to negotiate without prior integration or coordination.

plugins.description:
NoPressure is a communication-skills practice for the workplace. It turns a hard conversation into a live voice roleplay you can rehearse before the real one: delivering critical feedback, saying no to a request, handling a performance review, pushing back on a stakeholder, negotiating a raise, running a first 1:1 with a new team.

Describe the situation once — who the other person is, where they stand, and what makes it hard. ChatGPT can assemble that brief from what is already in the conversation, including anything you have brought in from the other tools you use, so the character is built on the real people and the real stakes instead of a generic template. NoPressure sees only the brief it is handed: it has no access to your calendar, mail, or documents. From that brief, it generates the character, a scene image, and a voice, then shows a start card in the chat. Pressing Start opens the voice call in the NoPressure web app, where you speak out loud with someone who holds their own position and pushes back.

When the session ends, the debrief comes back to the card: the key insight, how you handled the core challenge, and where to focus next. Send it into the chat, with the transcript of what was said, and work through it with ChatGPT. Simulations are reusable, so you can run one again and compare the attempt against an earlier try, or edit its title, card description, and character first. Each one lives in your own private NoPressure workspace.

It understands the way you actually talk: "in 30 minutes," "tomorrow at 9," "every morning at 8," "every other Friday." plugins.description:
Omphalis is the place where what you read, hear, and note begins to cohere. You save an article, and Omphalis shows its structure. You listen to a podcast on your commute, and Omphalis helps you come back to what mattered. You watch a two-hour talk, and Omphalis shows you the shape of it in seconds. You record a voice note at midnight, and Omphalis places it beside the article, talk, or paper that belongs with it.

The paper you read last spring meets the book you are reading now, and your voice note from a walk last month sits beside both. What changed in the field, what changed in your understanding, what still holds: all part of the same library, still in reach, still connected. Not a pile that grows heavier. A place that gets clearer.

It is for people who need what they consume to stay usable later — in writing, teaching, decision-making, research, or reflection — where understanding can compound over time.

Omphalis is a companion for long content: a map for structure, a margin for meaning, and a way back to the moments that matter.

plugins.name: app-6a2a589865a88191933e9bad10f5bc67
plugins.description:
Exercise now or wait. Sell at vest or hold. Which lots to sell first. Each of these has a right answer for your specific situation, and it turns on how alternative minimum tax (AMT), holding periods, state tax, and the time value of taxes paid early interact across several years. That is where rules of thumb break down. Ask in plain language and OptionsAhoy returns the answer with the year-by-year schedule behind it.

1. Which incentive stock options (ISOs) to exercise in which year, to hold down AMT and recover the credit later. We optimize across multiple years, with your tax status in mind.

2. Whether to sell restricted stock units (RSUs) at vest or hold for long-term capital gains, and what the twelve-month cliff is actually worth. We show you the optimal solution.

3. Which vested RSU lots to sell and in what order, and what that saves against selling oldest-first (the default order your broker's UI will offer). This sounds like a minute optimization. On a $725,000 sale from a concentrated position, the gap between the optimal order and your broker's default could be over $100,000 in tax.

4. Whether non-qualified stock options (NSOs) are better exercised and sold, or exercised and held.

5. Whether your shares pass the six statutory tests for qualified small business stock (QSBS). Best to check early for potential tax savings, the rules just changed.

6. How exposed a single position leaves you, and what selling down, holding, or hedging each cost. We calculate and compare different strategies across three years, with your taxes in mind.

7. What a protective put or a zero-cost collar prices at. If you need to protect your holdings, you're probably considering a hedge. But which one? We make it easy to decide.

8. How to convert some of your holdings to a target amount of after-tax cash by a deadline with the smallest tax bill. We optimize against your inputs and risk tolerance, then you choose, the way an investment firm would.

Every result is computed against the federal tax code plus all fifty states and the District of Columbia. The 2026 federal constants match IRS Revenue Procedure 2025-32. Federal cases reproduce to the cent against the independently maintained PSL Tax-Calculator, and state results reproduce to the cent against OpenTaxSolver across California, New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, and Massachusetts. That proof recomputes live in your browser at optionsahoy.com/verification.

This matters because language models are confident and wrong at exactly this task. In a published benchmark, five frontier models were given the same multi-year ISO problem, three runs each. All five overstated the after-tax value of their own proposed schedules, by 1.6x to 17.6x against the provable optimum. One model claimed $3.9M, $5.2M, and $13.0M on three runs of identical input. The prompt and full transcripts are public at optionsahoy.com/benchmark. The arithmetic here is deterministic instead: the same inputs on the same date give the same answer every time, with no model inference anywhere in the number.

Free, no account, no API key, and your figures are not retained. United States tax logic only. This is a planning calculator, not tax advice.

plugins.description:
The human intelligence layer for AI.

OriginalVoices gives ChatGPT instant access to real human perspectives - so you can ground decisions and AI outputs in what your target audience actually thinks, feels, and values.

Instead of guessing or relying on assumptions, get authentic feedback from real people directly inside ChatGPT. Share ideas, test messaging, validate concepts, or explore what matters to any audience - and use those insights to understand your audience, inform better decisions and create more targeted AI outputs.

With OriginalVoices, you can:
- Define any target audience
- Share anything - questions, links, copy, product concepts, campaign ideas
- Get instant responses from our network of tens of thousands of Digital Twins - AI representations of real people, each owned, trained, and validated by the person they represent

What you can use OriginalVoices for
- OriginalVoices brings real human intelligence into ChatGPT - turning every conversation into an opportunity to understand and act on authentic audience perspectives.
- Test messaging, copy, or creative concepts with your target audience
- Understand what people care about and why it matters to them
- Get feedback on landing pages, product ideas, or campaign strategies
- Create content and ads that resonates with specific audiences
- Compare perspectives across different demographics or segments
- Conduct qualitative research without the wait

How it works
- Tag OriginalVoices in ChatGPT
- Describe your target audience (e.g., "parents of toddlers in the UK," "Gen Z interested in sustainability," "small business owners")
- Share what you want feedback on - a question, a URL, an idea, copy you've written - anything
- OriginalVoices identifies relevant Digital Twins and gathers their responses. Individual perspectives are returned directly in ChatGPT, giving you real human context to inform decisions and shape outputs.
- Get started with the OriginalVoices ChatGPT App today - and bring real human insight into your AI workflows.

plugins.description:
Everything your favorite kitchen management app does, and more, inside ChatGPT.

Pantry Persona remembers what's in your fridge, what your family can and can't eat, and which brands you prefer. It stores your recipes, plans your meals, builds your shopping lists, and tracks the nutrition behind it all, then keeps everything in sync as you cook and shop through the week

**Recipes** — Save a recipe from a website, a cooking video, or a social post, or just create one in conversation. Search by ingredient, cuisine, or what you can make right now with what's on hand, and group your favorites into collections.

**Meal plans** — Generate a full week of meals in one ask, or build it day by day. Plans respect your household's food preferences and eating rules automatically, and carry per-meal nutrition so you can see how the week shapes up.

**Shopping lists** — Visual, interactive lists organized by store. One tap checks items off. Ask for a shopping list from your meal plan and it skips anything already in your pantry. Send it to Instacart when you're ready to buy.

**Cook Mode** — Start cooking a recipe and get step-by-step guidance. When you're done, ingredients are deducted from your pantry and leftovers are tracked with expiration dates.

**Nutrition** —  See calories and macros on every recipe and meal, set your own daily targets for each person, and check how today or the week is stacking up. Log what you actually ate, even a meal out, and it counts toward your totals.

**Your kitchen, personalized** — Household profiles store each family member's food preferences, eating rules, favorite brands, and nutrition targets. Every suggestion, plan, and search filters through them so you don't have to repeat yourself. Invite other family members and everyone works from the same pantry, recipes, and shopping lists in real time.

Also tracks pantry expiration dates, predicts when you'll run low on staples, learns the brands and prices you buy, and turns grocery receipts into an up-to-date inventory and a clear picture of your spending.

plugins.description:
Patlytics brings concept-level, AI-native patent search into your assistant: semantic, not keyword-based. Describe an invention in plain prose and get the most relevant patents, look up any patent's claims, search the scientific literature, and pull your own organization's saved patents, all through structured, predictable tools (not a black box).


The five tools are read-only: semantic patent search (optionally anchored to a reference patent), patent lookup (bibliographic data and full claims), non-patent literature search (via OpenAlex), and listings of your organization's private portfolios and vault. Search is semantic, so a richer description (how an invention works, the problem it solves, its components) returns better results.


Access is for existing Patlytics users: each member signs in with their own account (OAuth), and results are scoped to their organization. Deeper work like freedom-to-operate opinions, infringement and invalidity claim charts, and patent drafting runs in the Patlytics web app, linked from every result.

plugins.description:
Pendar gives you the shape of a research field, not a summary of it.

Point it at a topic and it reports how many papers exist, whether output is growing or flattening, which disciplines and countries produce them, and which papers to read first. Every figure is counted across the whole corpus rather than estimated from a sample, so you can plan around it.

Point it at a paper and it traces what happened next: whether citations are rising or fading, which fields picked the work up, whether industry or academia is building on it, and which authors cite it most. That is how you tell a paper quietly becoming foundational from one that peaked years ago.

Paste a bibliography and it checks each reference against the published record: whether the paper exists, whether the citation describes it accurately, and whether it has been retracted. A reference it cannot find is reported as unverified rather than swapped for the nearest real paper, which matters when the citations came from a model.

Every tool is read-only. Pendar looks things up and reports what it finds.

plugins.description:
"Pet Project Co-Founder AI" is your market research assistant.

It will help you validate product ideas using real data from trusted market research services. No more guesses or hallucinations. Instead of relying on plain LLM-only answers, you will use raw market data interpreted by ChatGPT as clear insights.

You do not need prior marketing experience. You just ask a question and the app builds a market research plan for you. The plan will include gathering data from third-party services. You are guided through what services to use and what queries to run there. After you use the recommended service, you copy-paste their data back to the app and get a clear interpretation from ChatGPT.

Examples of questions you can get answers to:
- "I have an idea for the app X. Is there enough demand to justify building it?"
- "What are people searching for when they want Y?"
- "Who exactly is my target user for the app Z? What platforms do they use?"
- "I built an app W. Where do I find users for it?"

For now, the following services are supported:
- SparkToro — audience intelligence (who your users are, what they read, who they follow)
- Ubersuggest — keyword demand and SEO metrics
- AnswerThePublic — real search questions and phrasing

Disclaimers:
- This app does not automatically gather data from the recommended market research services. The app helps with building search queries for these services and reporting the resulting data back. But you will need to visit and use these services yourself. We do not automatically scrape data from these services.
- This app does not provide paid subscriptions to the recommended market research services. You use these services according to their terms of use.
- This app currently supports a limited set of services: SparkToro, Ubersuggest, and AnswerThePublic. Only these services may be recommended during marketing research. Keep in mind that there are other good services for market research on the internet, we just do not support them yet. You can request adding new services by emailing the [developer@petprojectcofounder.ai](mailto:developer@petprojectcofounder.ai)
- For the best experience, it is recommended to use this app on desktop

plugins.description:
Pexafy searches photographs the way you would describe them to a person.

Ask for "someone working alone late at night in a quiet apartment, lit only by a
warm desk lamp" and you get photographs that match the scene — not photographs
tagged with those words. Search runs across nine free-license sources at once
(Unsplash, Pexels, Pixabay, Kaboompics, Burst, StockSnap, Picjumbo, Skitterphoto,
NegativeSpace) instead of one provider at a time.

Three tools, all read-only:

search_photos — describe a scene in a sentence, optionally filtered by colour,
orientation, source, licence, photographer or date.

search_photos_by_image — give a reference image and get visually similar
photographs, optionally adjusted in words: "like this, but at night".

get_similar_photos — more photographs like one already found, which is how you
keep a set visually consistent across an article or a deck.

Every result carries the credit line to display, the image at several sizes, and
its dimensions, dominant colour, orientation, source and licence. Results are
numbered, so you refer to a photograph the way you would in conversation —
"more like the third one" — rather than copying identifiers around.

In clients that render MCP Apps, results appear as a thumbnail grid inside the
conversation, and clicking one opens its full metadata without another call.

The connector is hosted, so there is nothing to install and no API key to paste
into a configuration file: you sign in to Pexafy once in a browser and the
connector receives its own credential, separate from your password and revocable
on its own. It is granted read access only and never asks for more.

A free Pexafy account covers 5,000 searches a month, with no card required.

plugins.description:
PFT EdgeBook connects your AI assistant to your own trading journal. Once linked, your assistant can read your real trading data. Just ask about your performance in plain language instead of digging through spreadsheets.

Ask things like "How did my breakout setups perform this month?", "Where am I losing the most?" or "Am I sticking to my own rules?" — and get answers based on your actual trades.

Your assistant can read:
- Trades — entries, exits, size, P&L, R-multiple, tags
- Statistics — win rate, profit factor, average win/loss
- Journal & notes — your daily reflections and voice notes

Requires an EdgeBook account (part of the PFT Terminal) with the AI add-on enabled.

plugins.description:
PlatoForms is an online form builder for web forms, fillable PDF forms and PDF documents. This plugin connects your PlatoForms account so you can work with your own forms and their submissions in conversation, instead of opening the dashboard.

What you can do

• Find forms. List published, draft or archived forms with their folder, publish state and submission count, or search by name.

• Understand a form. Read a form's full field schema — every field's id, type, label, whether it is required, its options and its validation rules — so you can reason about the data before you touch it.

• Review submissions. List a form's submissions newest-first, filter them by date range or keyword, find one by an exact field value (for example the submission where the email field is a particular address), and read every answer of a single submission with its field labels.

• Export. Mint a time-limited download URL for a submission's PDF, CSV, signing certificate, zipped attachments or a single attachment. Files are never streamed through the conversation — you get a link that expires.

• Share a prefilled link. Create one or more tracked invitation links to a form with fields already filled in, optionally single-use, optionally with an expiry. The plugin returns the URLs for you to send; it never sends email itself.

• Submit an entry. Post an entry to a published form after reading its schema, with validation errors returned verbatim so mistakes can be corrected and resubmitted.

• Start something new. Describe a form or a PDF document in plain English and get a builder link back. The design happens in the PlatoForms builder when you open the link, with its own AI asking you the clarifying questions.

How it connects

Sign in with your PlatoForms account over OAuth — your password is never shared with the assistant, access is scoped to read or read-and-write, and you can revoke it at any time from your PlatoForms account. The plugin can only see what your own account can see. A team owner controls whether the team is reachable this way at all, from Account → API.

Requirements

A PlatoForms account on a plan that includes API access. Actions count against your plan's API allowance. Teams in HIPAA mode have this access switched off by default and must opt in explicitly; data sent to a third-party AI assistant is not covered by the PlatoForms Business Associate Agreement.

What the plugin cannot do

It cannot edit an existing form or document, publish, delete, rename or duplicate anything, send email, or configure workflows, integrations or notifications. Those stay in the PlatoForms editor.

plugins.description:
Postbeam connects ChatGPT to your LinkedIn content workflow so you can draft, review, schedule, and analyze posts without leaving the chat. 

Once connected with your Postbeam account, ChatGPT works directly with your real posts, your writing guidance, and your performance data. Turning a chat box into the place you actually run your LinkedIn presence & strategy.

Draft in your voice, from your real work:
Ask ChatGPT to write a post and it pulls in your Postbeam content training, your mission, audience, format rules, and content sources so every draft sounds like you, not generic. Because it's working inside ChatGPT, it can also draw raw material from the other tools you've connected (Slack threads, Gmail, meeting recorders like Fellow or Granola) and turn a real customer calls, shipped features, or team wins into finished posts. Drafts are saved straight into Postbeam for review.

Edit, organize, and manage your queue:
Review your most recent drafts, pull up any single post, and edit its copy or title — all by chatting. You can attach media: images, video, or carousel posts. List posts by status (draft, approved, scheduled) to see exactly where everything stands.

Approve and schedule when you're ready:
When a draft is ready, ChatGPT can approve it and schedule it to publish to your connected LinkedIn at a specific time. Nothing publishes automatically drafts stay drafts until a person decides otherwise, and approving or scheduling respects the permissions on your account.

Understand what's working:
Ask what's performing and get answers from your cached analytics: account-level totals (impressions, reactions, comments, reshares, followers gained, members reached) with a daily trend, plus per-post breakdowns over 30-, 90-, or 365-day windows. Use it to spot your best formats and hooks, then immediately draft your next post in that proven style.

Built for teams and agencies:
Postbeam supports multiple accounts in one place. ChatGPT can list every account you can access, so agencies and teams can switch between clients or teammates and keep each person's drafts, approvals, and analytics cleanly separated.

plugins.description:
Prezi's plugin takes slides you already have, made in ChatGPT, generated in another tool, or uploaded as a PowerPoint or PDF, and places them on Prezi's open, zoomable canvas, turning a flat deck into a highly visual, interactive presentation. You get a full suite of presentation, engagement, and sharing tools that go beyond static slides: engagement features like polls, quizzes, and Q&A help you teach, sell, and give your ideas traction long after the slides are made.

Already have a deck? Bring it in. Or describe a topic and Prezi will build one for you, with an inline animated preview as it renders. Revise in place: add, edit, reorder, or remove slides and switch themes.

Present and share your way:
Present live with your content next to you in an interactive video with Newscaster mode
Share and export it as a narrated video or a podcast
Share one interactive link where your audience can answer polls and quizzes, submit and upvote questions, and respond to word clouds live or on their own time
Export to PDF, PowerPoint, or SCORM

Every deck lands in your own Prezi account. New decks are unlisted: they are not listed publicly or indexed, and anyone with the share link can open them. You can change a deck's visibility at any time in Prezi. Signing in with your Prezi account is required.

Sample prompts:
@Prezi create an interactive lesson about [topic] for [audience]. Include an opening poll, a visual explanation, a demonstration, two knowledge checks, a word cloud, and a final quiz.
@Prezi turn the attached presentation into a zoomable, interactive presentation for [audience]. Create a clear presentation path and add an opening poll, a word cloud after [section], a moderated Q&A, a five-question quiz, and a feedback activity.
@Prezi review this presentation and add audience activities in the most useful places. Include an opening poll, a midpoint word cloud, a moderated Q&A, a five-question closing quiz, and a feedback form.

Priority Guardian — Your priorities deserve more than good intentions.

Protected Time, Flexible Planning: Priorities don't fail because you stopped caring. They fail because everything else is loud and your most important work is quiet. Priority Guardian makes the quiet work visible — so you can protect it.

Built for people who do entrepreneurial work and juggle more than one thing at a time.

Priority Guardian connects your priorities to your Google Calendar so you can see where your time is actually going and stay accountable to what matters.

Deadline work — hours invested, pace against deadline, where effort is going
Ongoing commitments — weekly hour targets, streaks, monthly results check-in

5. Inspect and adjust weekly → "Let's dig into what helps me progress/ hinders my progress"

plugins.description:
Qualisend verifies email addresses and cleans lists so your messages reach real inboxes and bounces stay low. Ask it to check a single address, a batch, or a whole list — you get a clear deliverable / risky / undeliverable / unknown verdict for each, with typo suggestions and disposable- and role-address detection.

It runs the full check: syntax, domain and mail server (MX), disposable and role detection, catch-all, and a real mailbox (SMTP) check. Large lists run in the background and return a result summary you can review.

On the Pro plan it also checks whether a sending domain is set up correctly (SPF/DMARC), generates the DNS records you need (SPF, DMARC, BIMI, MTA-STS), and analyzes raw email headers to diagnose deliverability. With the Blacklist Monitoring add-on it can check whether a domain or IP is on major blacklists.

Each verification uses one Qualisend credit, and you connect your own Qualisend account.

plugins.description:
Quotient is an AI-native platform and intelligent agent in one; built to plan and execute campaigns across email, social, blog, and events, without the fragmented tools you've outgrown.

At its core, Quotient is an AI demand marketing platform. It brings everything that attracts customers: blogs, social posts, email, webinars and events, and brand-building, into one integrated workspace. You work with Quotient like a coworker. Describe what you want in plain English, and it takes it from there.

Campaigns organize your marketing around a central goal, like a feature launch or event. Each is a coordinated set of tasks and deliverables moving through a clear workflow. Deliverables are the real assets Quotient creates and ships: blog posts, email broadcasts, marketing events, automated flows, and social posts for X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. Ask Quotient to build a campaign end to end: it writes the brief, breaks the work into tasks, sets the timeline, and produces each deliverable.

Quotient gets smarter over time, drawing on a Knowledge Store of brand information, recording memories of your preferences, and using tools to search the web and pull from your audience of people and companies.

The result is a single platform where strategy, content, and execution live together, replacing the patchwork of disconnected marketing tools with one AI that plans, writes, and ships.

plugins.description:
Reclaim.ai  brings intelligent time management directly into ChatGPT, helping you plan, protect, and optimize your schedule

Instead of switching between tools to coordinate meetings and tasks, you can simply ask ChatGPT to organize your time. Reclaim connects to Google Calendar, Microsoft Outlook, and many popular task platforms and lets you plan your day, schedule meetings, and get things done right from within ChatGPT.

- Find the best times to meet based on availability
- Create, update, reschedule, or cancel events
- Quickly focus on your most important tasks
- Show your daily or weekly schedule
- Identify scheduling conflicts and recommend fixes
- Protect time for deep work and important tasks
- Analyze meeting load and focus time
- Help you understand how your time is spent

Try asking:

“What does my day look like?”
“Find 30 minutes with Alex and Sarah this week.”
“Block two hours for deep work tomorrow morning.”
“What should I work on?”
“Plan my week for focus time.”

Reclaim works with Google Calendar, Microsoft Outlook, Atlassian Jira, Linear, ClickUp, Asana, Todoist, and more.

Reevl gives ChatGPT direct access to Korea's official real estate transaction records.

Every price comes from actual, registered sales filed with Korea's Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport (MOLIT) — not listing prices, not estimates, not asking prices. Around 45,000 apartment complexes nationwide, updated daily.

Ask in plain language: "apartments in Gangnam under 2 billion won with more than 1,000 units", "complexes in Suwon where jeonse is above 70% of the sale price", or "which complexes has Reevl's model rated highest this year". Reevl filters the records and returns the matching complexes with sale prices, jeonse ratios, transaction volume, location scores, and Reevl's own price forecast.

Every response carries its units, its source, and its as-of date. The indices are computed from transaction records by Reevl rather than copied from a third party, and the method and update cadence are published openly.

Read-only. No listings, no brokerage, no transactions, and no personally identifiable information. The data is reference statistics, not investment advice.

plugins.description:
Rhizome's built an AI regulatory coworker that helps life sciences know what their regulator thinks.

We're backed by the same investors as Benchling and have gone from 0 -> >25 customers in the last 18 months. 

We've indexed >3 TB worth of data put out by the FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, etc., and built an agent that helps you:

 - each fact is backed by a citation, each citation is backed by the page of a health authority document 
 - much more comprehensive answers, as our AI goes up to 1,000 sources 
 - we've had no hallucinations reported last 18 months 

For more info, read rhizomeai.com/llms.txt

For support, reach out to support@rhizomeai.com

plugins.description:
RideDesk is booking and dispatch software for airport transfer, chauffeur,
  taxi and vehicle-rental operators — transfer management software that runs
  each operator's bookings, quotes, drivers, invoicing and payments under
  their own brand.

  This plugin serves RideDesk's developer documentation as queryable tools,
  so an agent can pull the exact API contract while building an operator's
  booking website: the three-call quote → book → checkout flow, embeddable
  booking widgets, visitor attribution, live chat, the customer portal, and
  each account's own MCP booking server for AI-agent bookings.

  It is read-only and requires no account or authentication. Actual quotes
  and bookings happen on an operator's own domain, never through this
  plugin — and prices are always computed server-side from the operator's
  own rate card, never by an agent.

  Typical uses: ask for the integration brief before building a booking
  site, look up the checkout contract, fetch widget embed snippets for a
  specific domain, or search the docs for captcha, attribution and
  customer-portal details.

plugins.description:
Roam Rule is a tax residency tracker and travel limits app for expats, founders, consultants, aircrew and frequent travellers who need a trustworthy record of where their days are adding up.

The mobile app keeps your travel record up to date in the background, shows where you have been on a map and helps you stay ahead of tax residency, Schengen 90/180, visa and time-away limits, custom limits, alerts, tax signals and days needing review.

In ChatGPT, you can ask plain-English questions about your Roam Rule record before booking a trip, checking a Schengen stay, preparing for an adviser call or setting up a regular check-in. Ask about logged countries, current counters, upcoming thresholds and unresolved travel days, then get a quick visual summary of what needs attention next.

With Roam Rule in ChatGPT you can:

- check where your travel days are adding up before booking a trip
- ask what to review before another Schengen or visa-sensitive journey
- use a planned itinerary in the conversation to ask what counters you should check first
- prepare a quick summary before speaking to an accountant, adviser or immigration professional
- set a regular ChatGPT check-in to remind you to review your Roam Rule counters and days needing attention

The app contains a checklist of common issues for different contract types:

- Freelance
- General agreements

- Use this app as an extra set of eyes - not a replacement for legal advice.
- Get a lawyer’s review for high-value, high-risk, or unfamiliar terms.
- Read the full contract and make sure you understand it before signing.

Outputs are AI-generated and may be inaccurate, incomplete, or outdated. Use it for informational purposes only and consult a qualified attorney for legal advice before signing. Do not use this app for criminal law matters, immigration matters, or family law disputes.

plugins.description:
Sellergoo is a profit-and-operations analytics service for online sellers. You connect the shops, marketplaces, payment and accounting accounts you already sell through, and Sellergoo brings the orders, fees, refunds, cost of goods, advertising and overhead together to work out what you actually earned — per channel, per product, per order.

This plugin lets you ask about those numbers in plain language instead of exporting spreadsheets. Ask what last month really made after fees, which SKUs are thin on margin, what a marketplace actually deposited in your bank account, or which products run out of stock first.

READ-ONLY
This plugin can only look. It cannot place, cancel, refund, reprice or change anything — not in Sellergoo, and not in any shop or marketplace you have connected. Every tool it exposes is read-only, and the access you grant it carries no permission to write. It reads figures that already belong to you, in answer to questions you ask.

WHAT IT CAN ANSWER
• Profit — sales, units, refunds, fees, cost of goods, ad spend, overhead, gross and net profit, margin and ROI for a period, combined and per channel.
• Profit and loss — a month-by-month P&L for up to the last 12 months, all channels or one.
• Orders — any date range, paginated, with each order's sales and marketplace fees.
• Products — per-SKU sales, units, margin and profit for a period, ranked by sales.
• Payouts — the settlements marketplaces and payment providers actually paid out, with the amounts grouped by line type.
• Inventory — stock on hand, 30-day sell-through and days of cover per SKU, one sales channel at a time.
• Alerts — stock-outs, low stock, thin margins, lost Buy Box, price changes and negative reviews.
• Channels — which shops are connected and when each last synced.

WHAT YOU NEED
A Sellergoo account (sellergoo.com). You sign in once and approve the connection; nothing is copied or pasted by hand. The answers are only as complete as the accounts you have connected — a brand-new account returns empty figures rather than errors, and you can always ask which account is being read.

Sellergoo works with Amazon, eBay, OTTO, Kaufland, Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy and Stripe, plus QuickBooks for accounting and UPS and FedEx for shipping. Walmart is planned and not available yet. Money is reported in euro.

INDEPENDENT PRODUCT
Sellergoo is made by Wolfsohn Handel (Hüseyin Kurtoglu Wolfsohn, Einzelunternehmen, Germany). It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by or certified by Amazon, eBay, OTTO, Kaufland, Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy, Stripe, Intuit, UPS or FedEx. Those names appear only to say which of your own accounts Sellergoo can read for you.

YOUR DATA
The figures returned are commercial: totals, fees, SKUs, stock and payouts. Order records carry no buyer names, addresses, e-mail addresses or payment details. Nothing returned here is used to train any model. You can cut the connection off at any moment in Sellergoo under Settings → API keys; it stops working immediately, with no grace period.

Documentation: https://sellergoo.com/docs/mcp
Privacy: https://sellergoo.com/privacy · Terms: https://sellergoo.com/terms
Support: info@wolfsohn.de

• Profit and loss — a month-by-month P&L for up to the last 12 months, all channels or one.
• Orders — any date range, paginated, with each order's sales and marketplace fees.
• Products — per-SKU sales, units, margin and profit for a period, ranked by sales.
• Payouts — the settlements marketplaces and payment providers actually paid out, with the amounts grouped by line type.
• Inventory — stock on hand, 30-day sell-through and days of cover per SKU, one sales channel at a time.
• Alerts — stock-outs, low stock, thin margins, lost Buy Box, price changes and negative reviews.
• Channels — which shops are connected and when each last synced.

WHAT YOU NEED
A Sellergoo account (sellergoo.com). You sign in once and approve the connection; nothing is copied or pasted by hand. The answers are only as complete as the accounts you have connected — a brand-new account returns empty figures rather than errors, and you can always ask which account is being read.

Sellergoo works with Amazon, eBay, OTTO, Kaufland, Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy and Stripe, plus QuickBooks for accounting and UPS and FedEx for shipping. Walmart is planned and not available yet. Money is reported in euro.

INDEPENDENT PRODUCT
Sellergoo is made by Wolfsohn Handel (Hüseyin Kurtoglu Wolfsohn, Einzelunternehmen, Germany). It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by or certified by Amazon, eBay, OTTO, Kaufland, Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy, Stripe, Intuit, UPS or FedEx. Those names appear only to say which of your own accounts Sellergoo can read for you.

YOUR DATA
The figures returned are commercial: totals, fees, SKUs, stock and payouts. Order records carry no buyer names, addresses, e-mail addresses or payment details. Nothing returned here is used to train any model. You can cut the connection off at any moment in Sellergoo under Settings → API keys; it stops working immediately, with no grace period.

Documentation: https://sellergoo.com/docs/mcp
Privacy: https://sellergoo.com/privacy · Terms: https://sellergoo.com/terms
Support: info@wolfsohn.de
defaultPrompts: What was my net profit last month, and which channel dragged it down?
Which of my products lost money last month after fees and ads?

plugins.name: app-69f63e01766881919640f03b5e7912a5
plugins.description:
SentinelX lets you manage your Linux servers from ChatGPT — no SSH required. Install a small open-source agent on any Linux box, and ChatGPT can run inspection commands, manage systemd services, read/search/edit files, run scripts, upload files, and call out to integrations like Cloudflare DNS, Resend, and Telegram.

Every action is constrained by a per-host allowlist that you control. The agent only runs commands and services you've explicitly declared safe, rejects anything outside the policy at the agent boundary, and Linux file permissions still apply on top. You can connect multiple servers and label them however you want.

Typical uses: check uptime and disk space, restart services, tail logs, edit nginx configs, run quick scripts, manage DNS records, send notifications. The agent is open source on GitHub (github.com/pensados/sentinelx-cloud-core). Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 with PKCE and Dynamic Client Registration, scoped per user.

plugins.description:
Dial in better espresso, one informed adjustment at a time.
Set up your beans, grinder, espresso machine, and scale once. After each shot, log the dose, yield, brew time, and how it tasted. ShotPulled considers the full context—including the coffee’s age and the way your grinder is calibrated—then recommends the single most useful adjustment for your next shot and explains why.
ShotPulled also keeps your coffee inventory accurate automatically. Every logged dose is deducted from the bag, so you can see the grams remaining and an estimate of how many shots are left based on the dose you actually use. It tracks the bag’s peak window too, showing how many peak days remain and the date that window ends.
When a recipe works, lock it in and return to it anytime. ShotPulled supports grinder settings across clicks, numbered collars, compound ring positions such as 1.2.2, and named settings, with built-in specifications for 67 grinders, 124 espresso machines, and 24 scales.
Your ShotPulled account stays in sync across ChatGPT, the web dashboard, and the iPhone app. Register a bag here, and it’s already waiting on your phone when you’re ready to pull your next shot.

plugins.description:
SkinKnowledgeBase is a public skincare knowledge website and AI-accessible reference layer for answering skincare and skincare-product questions with source-backed context.
For people, it offers readable pages about skincare questions, ingredients, products, concerns, side effects, cited sources, and product comparisons. For AI assistants, it provides read-only MCP access to the same public knowledge structure, so answers can include canonical SkinKnowledgeBase URLs, citations where available, product facts, ingredient context, comparison caveats, and clear uncertainty when source information is limited.
SkinKnowledgeBase is designed for transparent cosmetic-skincare reference, not medical advice. It avoids fake ratings, paid rankings, guaranteed outcomes, and unsupported “best overall” claims. It is useful for shoppers, researchers, content teams, and AI assistants that need grounded skincare context instead of vague beauty claims.

SlideForge turns a plain-language request or structured data into an editable PowerPoint file. Ask for a KPI summary, a project status dashboard, a roadmap, or a comparison — SlideForge renders a downloadable .pptx in about a second, with an inline preview so you can check the result in the conversation. Files open in PowerPoint, Google Slides, and Keynote.

Slides come from a catalog of 150+ patterns: KPI scoreboards, status dashboards, funnels, waterfalls, Gantt plans, org charts, roadmaps, and more. You can build multi-slide decks, convert PDFs and slide images into editable PowerPoint, translate decks into 32 languages, and apply your own brand themes and logo. There is also a code mode for custom python-pptx layouts outside the catalog.

Numbers and text appear exactly as you provide them — rendering is deterministic, and every response reports whether the slide rendered completely and where anything was adjusted. SlideForge connects to your own account via OAuth.

plugins.description:
SmartSpectra is a contactless vital signs SDK from Presage Technologies. It measures heart rate and breathing rate from standard smartphone and webcam video using rPPG (remote photoplethysmography), on any device with a camera. No wearables, no contact sensors.

Developers use SmartSpectra rPPG for remote vital signs monitoring, telehealth intake, contactless health checks, employee wellness screening, driver fatigue detection, clinical trial screening, and digital biomarker collection across iOS, Android, and web.

Use this connector to retrieve SDK credentials and API keys, inspect plan usage, manage registered mobile applications, locate application configuration files, and search SmartSpectra rPPG integration documentation.

Also measured: heart rate variability (HRV) and electrodermal activity, with ongoing work in contactless blood pressure.

The SmartSpectra SDK is built by Presage Technologies, who in 2026 received FDA 510(k) clearance (K254169) for heart rate and breathing rate in its SmartSpectra Vital Signs Monitor 1.0. Presage serves healthcare, government, and wellness markets from Leesburg, Virginia, USA.

plugins.name: app-6a6b58be0398819182d203d30a4f6df6
plugins.description:
STACK is a construction takeoff and estimating platform used by estimators and preconstruction teams. This connector links your AI assistant to your STACK account so you can work with your projects, takeoffs, and estimates just by describing what you want — no code, and nothing to install.

Once connected, your assistant can:
• Find and review existing work — search projects and takeoffs, open and review estimates, and look things up in your takeoff libraries.
• Create, update, and import — start new projects (including straight from an invitation-to-bid email), update project details, make bulk edits to takeoffs, and import from your libraries and company lists.

You stay in control. You sign in on STACK's own secure page using standard OAuth 2.0 — your assistant never sees your password. A STACK-branded approval screen lets you choose exactly which capabilities to grant, and you can allow read-only work (finding and reviewing) without allowing changes. Before it creates, updates, or imports anything, your assistant shows you what it's about to do and waits for your approval.

Your existing STACK permissions always apply: the connector can only see and change what you already could, and STACK enforces the same company ownership and user permissions it always has.

plugins.description:
Bring an AI-powered visual design workflow into ChatGPT and Codex. Create, refine, review, and export polished, editable designs through natural conversation.

What you can create: AI presentations and pitch decks, posters and flyers, social media graphics, infographics, diagrams, cards, email designs, web concepts, UI mockups, and visual documents.

Create presentations: Turn a topic, outline, brief, or existing content into a polished, editable presentation. Create posters: Design event posters, promotional graphics, flyers, and visual art in any supported format. Create social media content: Produce editable designs for Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, and other channels. Create infographics and diagrams: Transform complex ideas, processes, and data into clear visual stories.

Recreate designs: Provide an image, screenshot, website, document, or design.md file as a visual reference. StarryKit analyzes its composition, typography, colors, hierarchy, and visual language, then recreates the direction with editable elements—without requiring a template.

Edit and refine: Rewrite complete pages or request focused changes to text, layout, colors, imagery, hierarchy, and formatting while preserving the rest of the design. Review generated page drafts in StarryKit before accepting them into your document.

Export designs: Download your finished work as PowerPoint, PDF, SVG, PNG, JPEG, or HTML, or export an editable presentation to Google Slides.

Once installed, describe what you want in plain language or invoke StarryKit directly with @StarryKit.

Try prompts like:
- @StarryKit, create a 10-slide investor pitch deck for a sustainable urban farming startup.
- @StarryKit, design a bold poster for an electronic music festival in Tokyo.
- @StarryKit, turn this report into a clear, visual infographic.
- @StarryKit, recreate this website screenshot as an editable visual design.
- @StarryKit, make the headline larger, highlight the key metric, and preserve everything else.
- @StarryKit, export this presentation to PowerPoint and Google Slides.

plugins.name: app-6a6fc95ba1f0819190aa1d20ae56d0ec
plugins.description:
StrategyTune is a backtesting platform for trading strategies, and this plugin gives ChatGPT hands-on access to it.

ChatGPT can write and save the pieces you build with — chart indicators, reusable market conditions (StrategyTune calls them signals and filters), and full trading strategies — then run them tick-by-tick against real historical market data in StrategyTune's sandboxed cloud. A simple strategy backtests a year of history in seconds, so you can iterate fast.

It is not limited to automated strategy backtesting. ChatGPT can run custom research code in the same sandbox: count how often a condition occurred, measure values at specific moments, gather your own statistics and write logs during the run. You say what you want to check, ChatGPT writes the code, runs it, reads the output back, and tells you what it found.

When a run finishes you get the full report — performance statistics and the individual trades behind them. ChatGPT can also work with a StrategyTune chart you already have open: read the bars and each indicator's computed values, add and configure indicators, mark those conditions on the timeline so you can see exactly when they held, and switch instrument or timeframe. Reading the computed values also lets it debug its own work: if an indicator it wrote looks wrong on your chart, it can check the actual numbers behind the line instead of guessing.

Everything runs on historical data. The plugin does not connect to a broker, place live orders, or give investment advice.

plugins.description:
**Subtext is session replay built for agents instead of humans.**

Connect Subtext, and your Codex agents can open real production sessions and investigate them directly—no scrubbing a timeline, no video to watch.

Hand your agent a Subtext link from wherever it already connects—a Sentry issue, a Linear ticket, a support thread, a PR—and it uses Agentic Session Review to jump to the right moment, inspect screenshots and accessibility trees, diff DOM state, and read console and network activity to find the root cause. Then it files the fix or hands you the finding. You review the answer, not the replay.

What your agent gets:
* **Session tools it calls directly**: open a session, jump to a moment, inspect and compare state—purpose-built so agents traverse dense session data efficiently, with fewer tokens than pointing a general agent at raw replay.
* **Best-in-class capture from Fullstory**: Fullcapture behavior, pixel-perfect screenshots on demand, DOM diffs, and windowed console and network context.
* **Privacy built for production**: precision tools for agents to mask or exclude sensitive fields, plus agent-friendly DLP scanning tools over MCP.
* **Cost-effective**: Capture every session without sampling and never miss a critical user experience or bug report. Agents review the ones that matter most.

Works with Codex or any MCP-compatible agent. Code-first install, self-serve signup, generous free tier, usage-based pricing. Bring your own agent harness—Subtext is the session context it was missing.

plugins.name: app-6a83795db1e48191be5a38ce59cd2c0b
plugins.description:
SuperMCP prices a shopping list against Israeli online supermarkets and tells you which store delivers it for the least, to your address.

Give it a list in Hebrew and a delivery address. It matches each item to real products in each chain's catalogue, adds delivery fees where the chain publishes verified terms, and returns a per-store total with a per-item breakdown, plus a link to each product on the retailer's own site.

It is built not to guess. Items a store does not carry are marked missing rather than swapped silently, every price carries the date it was last seen in the chain's price file, and a delivery fee is quoted only when the chain publishes terms that have been verified. When several products match one line, it asks you instead of picking for you.

Prices come from the price files Israeli retailers publish under the Price Transparency Law, ingested nightly.

Coverage is Israeli online supermarket delivery, and the product catalogue is in Hebrew.

plugins.description:
Draft, revise, and organize the scripts you read on camera, without leaving the conversation. Connect your Teleprompter.com account and ChatGPT can write a script with you, then save it straight to your workspace, filed in the right folder and ready for your next take.

What ChatGPT can do:

- Create scripts with playback settings applied as they're written: font size, scroll speed, timed-speed mode, text alignment, and estimated duration
- Revise existing scripts in place. Updates touch only the fields you ask for, so the rest of your setup stays as you left it
- Read your library: list scripts newest first, pull the full text of any script, and see what's inside each folder
- Organize: create folders, rename them, and move scripts between folders or back to the root

Because ChatGPT can read what you've already written, you can work from your own back catalogue: ask for a tighter cut of last month's intro, a 30-second version of a product explainer, or a consistent sign-off across everything in one folder.

You'll need a Teleprompter.com account; the integration is available on every account tier. Connecting uses OAuth, so there are no keys to copy or store, and you choose which permissions to grant: reading and writing scripts and folders are separate approvals, so read-only access is a valid choice. ChatGPT only ever sees your own personal workspace.

Scripts saved here are the same scripts your Teleprompter apps read, so anything drafted in a conversation is waiting for you the next time you open one up.

plugins.description:
Testifly helps developers, QA engineers, and product teams validate websites and web applications with automated end-to-end (E2E) testing, website checks, and UI validation directly from a URL. Run browser-based tests to verify user flows, page behavior, redirects, availability, performance, accessibility, and overall site health without any setup. Whether you're testing a production site, staging environment, preview deployment, or local environment, Testifly quickly identifies issues before they reach users.

Testifly is especially valuable for AI-assisted and vibe coding workflows, where code is generated rapidly by AI coding agents. As development accelerates, automated end-to-end validation is critical to ensure features actually work in the browser. Testifly provides an independent verification layer that catches broken user flows, regressions, UI issues, and deployment problems that AI-generated code or unit tests may miss.

Integrated with ChatGPT, Testifly lets you create, run, and analyze end-to-end tests using natural language. It works alongside AI development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, and other coding agents, enabling developers to verify changes continuously without writing test code. Generate structured test reports, validate bug fixes, monitor regressions, and confidently ship high-quality web applications.

plugins.description:
Trusted by over 47 million people, Todoist simplifies tasks for individuals and teams. Instantly declutter your mind, boost productivity and use it as a habit tracker.

With a simple tap, add your tasks and remind yourself about them, enjoy multiple views like calendar, list and boards, filter tasks by work and/or personal life, collaborate on projects, and achieve peace of mind.

Why choose Todoist?
Todoist is a simple yet powerful planner tool that organizes both your life and work.

• Create a habit of adding tasks like “Plan next week’s work every Friday afternoon” or “Do homework every Wednesday at 6pm” using Todoist’s powerful language recognition and recurring dates.
• View any project as a list, as boards or as a calendar planner to give you ultimate flexibility when planning both your tasks and your time.
• Available on any device – with apps, extensions, and widgets – Todoist is everywhere you need it to be.
• Link Todoist with your calendar, voice assistant, and 100+ other tools such as Outlook, Gmail, and Slack.
• Collaborate on projects of all sizes by assigning tasks to others. Keep everything at hand by adding deadlines, notes, and files.
• Use one-tap templates to tackle everything from meeting agendas and accounting tasks, to packing lists and wedding planning.
• Instantly see what’s most important by setting visual task priority levels.
• Get to know your routine better with insights into your personalized productivity streaks.

Todoist on Apple iOS
• Todoist is beautifully designed, simple to get started, and intuitive to use.
• Stay organized from your iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch, while also syncing across desktop and all other devices.
• With natural language, write tasks like "tomorrow at 4pm" or “every other wednesday starting in two weeks” and Todoist will instantly parse it all out for you.
• Location-based reminders available on upgrade. Never forget an errand again.
• All the power from iOS: Siri, Today widget, share extension, handoff, and quick actions.

Questions? Feedback? Visit todoist.com/help

> The Verge: “Simple, straightforward, and super powerful”
> Wirecutter: “It’s simply a joy to use”
> PC Mag: “The best to-do list app on the market”
> TechRadar: “Nothing short of stellar”

Narrow any search down by asking: direct flights only, morning departures, breakfast and free cancellation, automatic with unlimited mileage. Connect your Trabber account and you can pick your recent searches back up.

Trabber doesn't sell travel. You book, pay and get support on the seller's website, under their terms.

TriAstra creates personalized birth charts and natal horoscopes in ChatGPT across three traditions: Western astrology, Vedic astrology (Jyotish/Kundli), and Korean Saju (Korean Four Pillars/Myeongri).

Enter your birth date, birth time, and birthplace, then choose the tradition you want to explore. The interactive result highlights the placements and patterns that matter most in your chart and explains the calculation behind them in plain language. If your birth time is unknown, TriAstra keeps the reading to what can still be calculated reliably and leaves out houses, angles, and other time-dependent conclusions. For Saju, biological sex is used only to determine the traditional Daeun direction.

Western and Vedic charts use Swiss Ephemeris astronomical data; Saju follows Korean Myeongri principles. TriAstra is designed for individual natal readings rather than daily forecasts or relationship matching. Results are for reflection and entertainment and are not medical, legal, financial, or other professional advice.

conversation and returns responses in that language, including right-to-
left layout for Arabic.

plugins.description:
TwinMind captures everything you say and hear in your meetings, lectures, and in-person conversations. It automatically transcribes, summarizes, proactively offers suggestions and tasks, and continuously builds context for your AI Second Brain.
TwinMind is a productivity tool leveraging AI to function as your second brain. It captures everything heard, seen, and said—growing with you the more you interact and engage with TwinMind to build a comprehensive context of your digital life. This captured context enables several key features:
Personalized and Proactive Assistance: TwinMind provides tailored suggestions and ideas based on your captured memories, anticipating needs and offering relevant insights.
Streamlined Productivity: It enhances your notetaking by having your AI assistant automate tasks such as generating summaries and action items from meetings and conversations. You can search their entire memory bank, ask questions, generate emails and study guides, investor memos, project plans, and more.
Privacy Focus: TwinMind prioritizes user privacy through on-device transcription, options to save transcripts locally or on the cloud. We're committed to zero third-party data sharing. Audio is processed on-the-fly and never stored.
Key Features and Functionality:

Capture and Context Building: Captures your activity (audio, visual, text) on mobile and desktop if partnered with the TwinMind chrome extension.
Personalized Suggestions: Your AI sidekick will offer tailored insights based on captured memories.
Automated Summaries and Action Items: Extracts key information from meetings, conversations, and class lectures.
Searchable Memory Bank: Allows you to search your captured history and notes.
Ask TwinMind Anything: Enables you to ask questions and receive answers with context of your memories or active meetings.
Content Generation: Facilitates the creation of follow up emails, study guides, and other documents to help increase your productivity.
Privacy Protection: Employs on-device transcription, choice to switch to private mode to store transcriptions locally, and no third-party data sharing.

TwinMind aims to boost your productivity by providing a centralized, AI-powered platform that captures, organizes, and leverages your captured memories to offer personalized assistance and automate tasks, all while safeguarding your privacy.

plugins.description:
Undermind is your AI co-researcher for the scientific literature. Ask a research question and Undermind searches the literature for you. It follows citation trails, evaluates hundreds of papers, and comes back with a ranked reading list rather than a page of keyword matches.

With Undermind you can:

- Run deep literature searches. Undermind's search agents explore a research question for a few minutes, then report back with a summary and a ranked list of relevant papers.

- Look up papers by topic, author, title, DOI, or citation relationships (papers citing or cited by a paper you know), with abstracts and citation metrics.

- Ask questions about a paper's full text, including its figures, tables, and equations, and check the answers against the source.

- Keep your work organized in workspaces with folders, starred papers, saved searches, and notes, all synced with your account at undermind.ai.

Scientists at thousands of research institutions use Undermind, from university labs to pharma R&D teams. Use it to check whether an idea is new, get oriented in an unfamiliar field, or track down the one method paper you need.

You'll need an Undermind account (free or paid) and to sign in when connecting.

plugins.description:
An information and calculation tool for visa applications by citizens of Türkiye (ordinary/burgundy passport).

It answers questions like "Do I need a visa for Japan?", "How much does a German visa cost?" and "How many Schengen days do I have left?" — always with its source.

What it covers:

· Visa status for 172 countries — 55 visa-free, 23 visa on arrival, 30 e-visa, 64 requiring a consulate application
· Per country: the fee, the published processing time, the application centre and the required documents
· Refusal rates for Schengen applications made from Türkiye, based on European Commission statistics (27 countries)
· Appealing a refusal: the competent authority, deadline, language and fee for seven Schengen countries, and the meaning of all 17 refusal grounds on the standard form
· Calculators: the Schengen 90/180 day allowance, multiple-entry (cascade) eligibility, and the total cost in Turkish lira at the central bank rate

How the data is collected:

Every amount and duration is verified against an official consulate, ministry or legislative source, quoted verbatim. A value that cannot be verified is not published — nothing is estimated; the field is left empty and said to be empty. Answers carry their source and last-updated date.

Only the consulate of the country concerned can grant a visa. We are not an agency: we do not file applications, book appointments, or guarantee approval.

Ask career questions in plain language: « how do I become a nurse in Lyon? », « I am a developer, which jobs could I move to? », « which jobs are hiring without long studies? ».
