plugins.description:
Describe the home you want — "a 10 by 10 house with a master bedroom and a private bathroom, two kids' rooms, an open kitchen and living room, a garden with trees" — and WalkMyPlan builds it in one go: real walls, doors, windows, furniture and garden. Open the live link and walk through it in 3D.

Keep designing in conversation. "Make the living room bigger." "Put a TV on the north wall." "I marked pin A — put the front door exactly there." Furniture placement is automatic — it finds a free spot, away from doorways. Every edit lands in a revision history you can undo or roll back to any point. Edits are for visualization and planning; WalkMyPlan does not check structural safety or building codes.

Ask about what you built. "How big is the kitchen?", "Is there room for a double bed in the small bedroom?" Answers are measured from the model's real geometry.

Share and collaborate. Share a plan privately with named people as viewers or editors, or with a link. See who changed what, when.

Already have a plan? Upload the real CAD file your architect sent — DWG or vector PDF, up to 100MB — and WalkMyPlan converts it into the same editable, walkable 3D model, so you start from reality instead of a blank page.

Great for home design, interior design, room planning, renovation, and planning a build. Your plans stay private to your account unless you share them, are never used to train AI models, and can be deleted any time (trash keeps them recoverable for 30 days).

Try: "Build me a three-bedroom house with a garden" — then "walk me through it."

Send files straight from your conversation with WeTransfer.

Connect your WeTransfer account and share any file from your chat — documents, images, exports, generated assets — without leaving the conversation. Just ask, and the connector uploads the files to WeTransfer and returns a clean, shareable download link. Prefer to send it directly? Add recipients and WeTransfer will email the transfer for you, sent from your own account.

What you can do
- Share one or many files at once and get a ready-to-share download link
- Email a transfer to one or more recipients, with an optional title and message
- Send large files without bloating the conversation

How it works
Every transfer is created in your own WeTransfer account, so it appears in your transfer history and follows your plan's limits and expiry. You sign in securely with your WeTransfer account — the assistant only ever gets permission to send files on your behalf, and never sees your WeTransfer password. You can disconnect at any time to revoke access.

plugins.name: app-6a797ad042008191aacd29609fc539f2
plugins.description:
Whisper Money is a privacy-first personal finance app: your financial data is yours, and it is never shared with third parties. This app connects ChatGPT to your own Whisper Money account so you can analyse your money in plain language instead of clicking through dashboards.

Ask questions like "how much did I spend on groceries last month", "what's my net worth trend this year", "which subscriptions are draining me" or "break down Q2 by category" — the app reads your transactions, accounts, categories, labels, cashflow and net worth and answers with your real numbers. You can also keep your books tidy from the conversation: log manual transactions, recategorize and label existing ones, record balances for manual accounts, and manage categories, labels and automation rules.

Your synced bank data is protected: transactions imported from a bank connection can be categorized and labelled, but never edited or deleted, and balances can only be recorded on manual accounts. You can still add your own manual transactions to a bank-connected account — a sync never removes them. Data is scoped to the account you sign in with, including any shared spaces you belong to. The app reads and writes bookkeeping records only — it can never move money, make payments or reach any account outside Whisper Money.

Requires a Whisper Money account on a paid (Pro) plan. Sign in happens through Whisper Money's own OAuth flow — ChatGPT never sees your password, and access can be revoked at any time from your account settings.

plugins.description:
Whiteboard by Athena AI (Athenaboard) is a AI-native Collaborative Whiteboard that can generate and share AI contents in realtime with your team.  

How to Get Started
- Simply describe what you want (e.g., "wireframes for a mobile app", "create a flowchart for user login", "show me the quadratic formula", "generate an image of a sunset")
- The app will automatically use the appropriate tool to render your request
- Use "add to whiteboard" to save any visualization for later

Core Features
1. Diagram Visualization
   - Render complex diagrams directly in ChatGPT including: flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, state diagrams, ER diagrams, Gantt charts, pie charts, mindmaps, timelines, and more
   - Powered by Mermaid.js for beautiful, interactive diagrams
   - Diagrams can be copied or added to your whiteboard

2. Wireframe Recommendation
   - Brainstorm UI/UX designs with your team in realtime
   - Over 10,000 editable templates for the AI to pick from
   - Get design components like buttons, cards, navigation elements, forms, etc.
   - Supports mobile, web, desktop, and tablet platforms

3. Collaborative Whiteboard
   - Add any visualization (diagrams, wireframes, images, LaTeX formulas) to a realtime collaborative whiteboard
   - Collaborate with your team in real-time
   - Persistent storage - your whiteboards are saved and accessible anytime
   - Each user has an active board that persists across conversations

4. LaTeX Visualization
   - Render complex scientific formulas and math equations in ChatGPT
   - Supports inline equations, full documents, and chemistry notation
   - Beautiful typesetting using KaTeX and full LaTeX compilation

5. Generate Image and Print on Product
   - Generate AI images from text descriptions with various styles (realistic, artistic, cartoon, sketch, abstract)
   - Create and buy custom products: T-shirts, mugs, hoodies, and pillows
   - Products are created via Printify and can be purchased directly

plugins.name: app-6a91fcd93878819188347d20f83fe2ee
plugins.description:
ChatGPT does the reasoning. WisdomAI brings the context.

WisdomAI is an agentic analytics platform that makes ChatGPT fluent in your business: what your metrics mean, how your data connects, and who is allowed to see what. It unifies your structured and unstructured data, disambiguates terms, and reconciles conflicts at runtime, so every answer lands on your approved definitions, with row-level and column-level security enforced on each query.

The same context that makes answers accurate also makes them efficient: each question carries only what it needs, reusing what WisdomAI already knows, so answers take fewer tokens with no accuracy trade-off.

That knowledge builds over time. WisdomAI learns from your usage, and you can teach it directly: define a new metric, or correct one whose meaning has drifted. Every conversation sharpens the next.

You can use WisdomAI in ChatGPT to:
- Ask questions of governed business data: "How did Q3 net revenue track against plans in EMEA?"
- Follow up in the same line of analysis: "Break that down by segment and show the last four quarters"
- Trace an answer to its definitions and sources: "Which definition of net revenue was used, and what data did it come from?”
- See what you can ask about: "What data do I have access to, and which metrics are defined for finance?"

plugins.name: app-6a7ed9d2070c8191b822a7a4e624e28b
plugins.description:
ラッコキーワード（RakkoKeyword）は、日本最大級のキーワードリサーチツールです。このプラグインを使うと、ChatGPTとの会話から直接キーワードリサーチとSEO分析を実行できます。

できること:
・Google・Bing・YouTube・Amazon・楽天などのサジェストキーワード取得
・独自データベースからの関連キーワード・よくある質問の取得
・LSIキーワード、他の人はこちらも質問（PAA）、同時ランクインキーワードといった関連トピックの探索
・月間検索数・SEO難易度・CPC・競合性の取得（月別推移つき）
・Google検索順位の実測
・競合分析: 任意のドメインが獲得しているキーワードと主力集客ページの抽出
・指定キーワードで検索流入を集めているページ・サイトの検索
・SEOライティング支援: 検索上位ページの見出し・共起語の抽出

活用例:
・SEO記事の構成案・タイトル・見出しの設計
・コンテンツ企画・ネタ出し、市場・需要調査
・競合サイトの自然検索の流入キーワード分析
・EC（Amazon・楽天）の商品リサーチ

日本の検索市場データに強みがあり、月間検索数の調査では海外の地域・言語の指定にも対応しています。利用にはラッコキーワードのアカウントが必要です。

plugins.description:
티에이치스터디는 개인이 작성한 콘텐츠와 데이터를 검색하고 활용할 수 있는 MCP 기반 AI 서비스입니다.
